title: A Directional-ODE Framework for Discretization of Advection-Diffusion Equations
authors: Amin Jafarimoghaddam, Manuel Soler, Irene Ortiz
abstract:
We present a novel approach that redefines the traditional interpretation of
explicit and implicit discretization methods for solving a general class of
advection-diffusion equations (ADEs) featuring nonlinear advection, diffusion
operators, and potential source terms. By reformulating the discrete ADEs as
directional ordinary differential equations (ODEs) along temporal or spatial
dimensions, we derive analytical solutions that lead to novel update formulas.
In essence, the information of discrete ADEs is compressed into these
directional ODEs, which we refer to as representative ODEs. The analytical
update formulas derived from the representative ODEs significantly enhance
stability, computational efficiency, and spatiotemporal resolution.
Furthermore, we extend the framework to systems with uncertain parameters and
coefficients, showcasing its versatility in addressing complex ADEs encountered
in modeling and simulation across diverse scientific and engineering
disciplines.

title: Adam assisted Fully informed Particle Swarm Optimzation ( Adam-FIPSO ) based Parameter Prediction for the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA)
authors: Shashank Sanjay Bhat, Peiyong Wang, Udaya Parampalli
abstract:
The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) is a prominent
variational algorithm used for solving combinatorial optimization problems such
as the Max-Cut problem. A key challenge in QAOA lies in efficiently identifying
suitable parameters (gamma, beta) that lead to high-quality solutions. In this
paper, we propose a framework that combines Fully Informed Particle Swarm
Optimization (FIPSO) with adaptive gradient correction using the Adam Optimizer
to navigate the QAOA parameter space. This approach aims to avoid issues such
as barren plateaus and convergence to local minima. The proposed algorithm is
evaluated against two classes of graph instances, Erdos Renyi and
Watts-Strogatz. Experimental results across multiple QAOA depths consistently
demonstrate superior performance compared to random initialization,
underscoring the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed optimization
framework.

title: CIR bridge for modeling of fish migration on sub-hourly scale
authors: Hidekazu Yoshioka
abstract:
Bridges, which are stochastic processes with pinned initial and terminal
conditions, have recently been applied to solve various problems. We show that
a bridge based on the Cox-Ingersoll-Ross process, called a CIR bridge in this
paper, reasonably models the intraday number of migrating fish at an
observation point in a river. The studied fish migrates between sunrise and
sunset each day, which are considered the initial and terminal times,
respectively. The CIR bridge is well-defined as a unique pathwise continuous
solution to a stochastic differential equation with unbounded drift and
diffusion coefficients and potentially represents the on-off intermittency of
the fish count data. Our bridge is theoretically novel in that it admits
closed-form time-dependent averages and variances, with which the model
parameters can be identified efficiently, and is computable by a
recently-developed one-step numerical method. The CIR bridge is applied to the
sub-hourly migration data of the diadromous fish Plecoglossus altivelis
altivelis in the Nagara River, Japan, from February to June.

title: Hadamard-$Π$: Equational Quantum Programming
authors: Wang Fang, Chris Heunen, Robin Kaarsgaard
abstract:
Quantum computing offers advantages over classical computation, yet the
precise features that set the two apart remain unclear. In the standard quantum
circuit model, adding a 1-qubit basis-changing gate -- commonly chosen to be
the Hadamard gate -- to a universal set of classical reversible gates yields
computationally universal quantum computation. However, the computational
behaviours enabled by this addition are not fully characterised. We give such a
characterisation by introducing a small quantum programming language extending
the universal classical reversible programming language $\Pi$ with a single
primitive corresponding to the Hadamard gate. The language comes equipped with
a sound and complete categorical semantics that is specified by a purely
equational theory, enabling reasoning about the equivalence of quantum programs
in a way that can be automated. Completeness is shown by means of a novel
finite presentation, and corresponding synthesis algorithm, for the groups of
orthogonal matrices with entries in the ring $\mathbb{Z}[\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}]$.

title: Accurate analysis of the pitch pulse-based magnitude/phase structure of natural vowels and assessment of three lightweight time/frequency voicing restoration methods
authors: Aníbal J. S. Ferreira, Luis M. T. Jesus, Laurentino M. M. Leal, Jorge E. F. Spratley
abstract:
Whispered speech is produced when the vocal folds are not used, either
intentionally, or due to a temporary or permanent voice condition. The
essential difference between natural speech and whispered speech is that
periodic signal components that exist in certain regions of the former, called
voiced regions, as a consequence of the vibration of the vocal folds, are
missing in the latter. The restoration of natural speech from whispered speech
requires delicate signal processing procedures that are especially useful if
they can be implemented on low-resourced portable devices, in real-time, and
on-the-fly, taking advantage of the established source-filter paradigm of voice
production and related models. This paper addresses two challenges that are
intertwined and are key in informing and making viable this envisioned
technological realization. The first challenge involves characterizing and
modeling the evolution of the harmonic phase/magnitude structure of a sequence
of individual pitch periods in a voiced region of natural speech comprising
sustained or co-articulated vowels. This paper proposes a novel algorithm
segmenting individual pitch pulses, which is then used to obtain illustrative
results highlighting important differences between sustained and co-articulated
vowels, and suggesting practical synthetic voicing approaches. The second
challenge involves model-based synthetic voicing. Three implementation
alternatives are described that differ in their signal reconstruction
approaches: frequency-domain, combined frequency and time-domain, and
physiologically-inspired separate filtering of glottal excitation pulses
individually generated. The three alternatives are compared objectively using
illustrative examples, and subjectively using the results of listening tests
involving synthetic voicing of sustained and co-articulated vowels in word
context.

title: Reducing Object Hallucination in Large Audio-Language Models via Audio-Aware Decoding
authors: Tzu-wen Hsu, Ke-Han Lu, Cheng-Han Chiang, Hung-yi Lee
abstract:
Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) can take audio and text as the inputs and
answer questions about the audio. While prior LALMs have shown strong
performance on standard benchmarks, there has been alarming evidence that LALMs
can hallucinate what is presented in the audio. To mitigate the hallucination
of LALMs, we introduce Audio-Aware Decoding (AAD), a lightweight inference-time
strategy that uses contrastive decoding to compare the token prediction logits
with and without the audio context. By contrastive decoding, AAD promotes the
tokens whose probability increases when the audio is present. We conduct our
experiment on object hallucination datasets with three LALMs and show that AAD
improves the F1 score by 0.046 to 0.428. We also show that AAD can improve the
accuracy on general audio QA datasets like Clotho-AQA by 5.4% to 10.3%. We
conduct thorough ablation studies to understand the effectiveness of each
component in AAD.

title: Meaning as Use, Application, Employment, Purpose, Usefulness
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
abstract:
Arising from the whole body of Wittgenstein's writings is a picture of a (not
necessarily straight, linear, but admittedly tireless) journey to come to terms
with the mechanics of language as an instrument to conceive `reality' and to
communicate an acquired conception of the `world'. The journey passes through
mathematics, psychology, color perception, certainty, aesthetic, but, looking
at it from a sort of birdview, it seems reasonable to say that these are all
used as `test beds' for his reflections and `experimentations' towards an all
encompassing perspective of such a fundamental gateway to human reasoning and
life-revealing as language. Whatever labelling of Wittgenstein as a mystic, a
logicist, a conventionalist, a skeptic, an anti-metaphysics, an anti-realist, a
verificationist, a pragmatist, and many others, does not seem to do justice to
his absolute obsession with being a persistent `deep diver' into the nature of
language. Working with an open and searchable account of the Nachlass has
allowed us to identify important aspects of the philosopher's possible common
line of thinking, in spite of changes of directions, some of them acknowledged
by Wittgenstein himself. One of those aspects is the association of meaning
with use, application, purpose, usefulness of symbols in language, which
happens to show itself from the very beginning through to the very late
writings. The German terms Gebrauch, Anwendung, \emph{Verwendung}, Zweck in
relation to meaning, sense of signs, words, sentences, appear in several texts
since the WW1 Notebooks (1914--1916) up until very late manuscripts from
1950--51.

title: Speaker-Distinguishable CTC: Learning Speaker Distinction Using CTC for Multi-Talker Speech Recognition
authors: Asahi Sakuma, Hiroaki Sato, Ryuga Sugano, Tadashi Kumano, Yoshihiko Kawai, Tetsuji Ogawa
abstract:
This paper presents a novel framework for multi-talker automatic speech
recognition without the need for auxiliary information. Serialized Output
Training (SOT), a widely used approach, suffers from recognition errors due to
speaker assignment failures. Although incorporating auxiliary information, such
as token-level timestamps, can improve recognition accuracy, extracting such
information from natural conversational speech remains challenging. To address
this limitation, we propose Speaker-Distinguishable CTC (SD-CTC), an extension
of CTC that jointly assigns a token and its corresponding speaker label to each
frame. We further integrate SD-CTC into the SOT framework, enabling the SOT
model to learn speaker distinction using only overlapping speech and
transcriptions. Experimental comparisons show that multi-task learning with
SD-CTC and SOT reduces the error rate of the SOT model by 26% and achieves
performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods relying on auxiliary
information.

title: Quantum SAT Problems with Finite Sets of Projectors are Complete for a Plethora of Classes
authors: Ricardo Rivera Cardoso, Alex Meiburg, Daniel Nagaj
abstract:
Previously, all known variants of the Quantum Satisfiability (QSAT) problem,
i.e. deciding whether a $k$-local ($k$-body) Hamiltonian is frustration-free,
could be classified as being either in $\mathsf{P}$; or complete for
$\mathsf{NP}$, $\mathsf{MA}$, or $\mathsf{QMA_1}$. Here, we demonstrate new
qubit variants of this problem that are complete for $\mathsf{BQP_1}$,
$\mathsf{coRP}$, $\mathsf{QCMA}$, $\mathsf{PI(coRP,NP)}$,
$\mathsf{PI(BQP_1,NP)}$, $\mathsf{PI(BQP_1,MA)}$, $\mathsf{SoPU(coRP,NP)}$,
$\mathsf{SoPU(BQP_1,NP)}$, and $\mathsf{SoPU(BQP_1,MA)}$. Our result implies
that a complete classification of quantum constraint satisfaction problems
(QCSPs), analogous to Schaefer's dichotomy theorem for classical CSPs, must
either include these 13 classes, or otherwise show that some are equal.
Additionally, our result showcases two new types of QSAT problems that can be
decided efficiently, as well as the first nontrivial $\mathsf{BQP_1}$-complete
problem. We first prove there are qudit QSAT problems that are complete for
$\mathsf{BQP_1}$, $\mathsf{coRP}$, and $\mathsf{QCMA}$ by re-defining elements
of the circuit-to-Hamiltonian transformation. We then show that any QCSP can be
reduced to a problem in qubits while maintaining the same complexity -
something believed not to be possible classically. The remaining six problems
are obtained by considering "sums" and "products" of the first seven QSAT
problems. Before this work, the QSAT problems generated in this way resulted in
complete problems for $\mathsf{PI}$ and $\mathsf{SoPU}$ classes that were
trivially equal to other known classes. We thus commence the study of these new
and seemingly nontrivial classes. While [Meiburg, 2021] first sought to prove
completeness for the first three classes, we note that his constructions are
flawed. Here, we rework them and obtain improvements on the required qudit
dimensionality.

authors: Steven Finch
abstract:
The title reflects the original intent of this paper -- to continue exploring
compositional square roots -- focusing on Walker's (1991) study of the Abel
equation $f(\exp(x/e))=f(x)+1$ for real $x \neq e$. An unexpected discovery
changed everything. We already knew that \'Ecalle (1974) developed theory
inspiring relevant calculations across years. Precise details, however, seemed

important not to overlook. The new algorithm is exceedingly simple and
outperforms a rival method, due to Mavecha & Laohakosol (2013), which we

title: SongBloom: Coherent Song Generation via Interleaved Autoregressive Sketching and Diffusion Refinement
authors: Chenyu Yang, Shuai Wang, Hangting Chen, Wei Tan, Jianwei Yu, Haizhou Li
abstract:
Generating music with coherent structure, harmonious instrumental and vocal
elements remains a significant challenge in song generation. Existing language
models and diffusion-based methods often struggle to balance global coherence
with local fidelity, resulting in outputs that lack musicality or suffer from
incoherent progression and mismatched lyrics. This paper introduces
$\textbf{SongBloom}$, a novel framework for full-length song generation that
leverages an interleaved paradigm of autoregressive sketching and
diffusion-based refinement. SongBloom employs an autoregressive diffusion model
that combines the high fidelity of diffusion models with the scalability of
language models. Specifically, it gradually extends a musical sketch from short
to long and refines the details from coarse to fine-grained. The interleaved
generation paradigm effectively integrates prior semantic and acoustic context
to guide the generation process. Experimental results demonstrate that
SongBloom outperforms existing methods across both subjective and objective
metrics and achieves performance comparable to the state-of-the-art commercial
music generation platforms. Audio samples are available on our demo page:
https://cypress-yang.github.io/SongBloom\_demo.

title: Quantum Information-Theoretical Size Bounds for Conjunctive Queries with Functional Dependencies
authors: Valter Uotila, Jiaheng Lu
abstract:
Deriving formulations for computing and estimating tight worst-case size
increases for conjunctive queries with various constraints has been at the core
of theoretical database research. If the problem has no constraints or only one
constraint, such as functional dependencies or degree constraints, tight
worst-case size bounds have been proven, and they are even practically
computable. If the problem has more than one constraint, computing tight bounds
can be difficult in practice and may even require an infinite number of linear
inequalities in its optimization formulation. While these challenges have been
addressed with varying methods, no prior research has employed quantum
information theory to address this problem. In this work, we establish a
connection between earlier work on estimating size bounds for conjunctive
queries with classical information theory and the field of quantum information
theory. We propose replacing the classical Shannon entropy formulation with the
quantum R\'enyi entropy. Whereas classical Shannon entropy requires infinitely
many inequalities to characterize the optimization space, R\'enyi entropy
requires only one type of inequality, which is non-negativity. Although this is
a promising modification, optimization with respect to the quantum states
instead of classical distributions creates a new set of challenges that prevent
us from finding a practically computable, tight worst-case size bound. In this
line, we propose a quantum version to derive worst-case size bounds. The
previous tight classical worst-case size bound can be viewed as a special limit
of this quantum bound. We also provide a comprehensive background on prior
research and discuss the future possibilities of quantum information theory in
theoretical database research.

title: Stability and Extension of Steady and Ranging Persistence
authors: Yann-Situ Gazull
abstract:
Persistent homology is a topological data analysis tool that has been widely
generalized, extending its scope outside the field of topology. Among its
extensions, steady and ranging persistence was developed to study a wide
variety of graph properties. Precisely, given a feature of interest on graphs,
it is possible to build two types of persistence (steady and ranging
persistence) that follow the evolution of the feature along graph filtrations.
This study extends steady and ranging persistence to other objects using
category theory and investigates the stability of such persistence. In
particular, a characterization of the features that induce balanced steady and
ranging persistence is provided. The main results of this study are illustrated
using a practical implementation for hypergraphs.

title: Refuting Perfect Matchings in Spectral Expanders is Hard
authors: Ari Biswas, Rajko Nenadov
abstract:
This work studies the complexity of refuting the existence of a perfect
matching in spectral expanders with an odd number of vertices, in the
Polynomial Calculus (PC) and Sum of Squares (SoS) proof system. Austrin and
Risse [SODA, 2021] showed that refuting perfect matchings in sparse $d$-regular
\emph{random} graphs, in the above proof systems, with high probability
requires proofs with degree $\Omega(n/\log n)$. We extend their result by
showing the same lower bound holds for \emph{all} $d$-regular graphs with a
mild spectral gap.

title: Lumina: Real-Time Mobile Neural Rendering by Exploiting Computational Redundancy
authors: Yu Feng, Weikai Lin, Yuge Cheng, Zihan Liu, Jingwen Leng, Minyi Guo, Chen Chen, Shixuan Sun, Yuhao Zhu
abstract:
3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has vastly advanced the pace of neural
rendering, but it remains computationally demanding on today's mobile SoCs. To
address this challenge, we propose Lumina, a hardware-algorithm co-designed
system, which integrates two principal optimizations: a novel algorithm, S^2,
and a radiance caching mechanism, RC, to improve the efficiency of neural
rendering. S2 algorithm exploits temporal coherence in rendering to reduce the
computational overhead, while RC leverages the color integration process of
3DGS to decrease the frequency of intensive rasterization computations. Coupled
with these techniques, we propose an accelerator architecture, LuminCore, to
further accelerate cache lookup and address the fundamental inefficiencies in
Rasterization. We show that Lumina achieves 4.5x speedup and 5.3x energy
reduction against a mobile Volta GPU, with a marginal quality loss (< 0.2 dB
peak signal-to-noise ratio reduction) across synthetic and real-world datasets.
zh_title: Lumina：通过利用计算冗余实现实时移动神经渲染
translation: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 极大地推动了神经渲染的进展，但它在当今的移动系统级芯片 (SoC) 上仍然计算量巨大。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了 Lumina，一个软硬件协同设计的系统，它集成了两个主要优化：一种新颖的 S^2 算法和一种辐射缓存机制 (RC)，以提高神经渲染的效率。S^2 算法利用渲染中的时间一致性来减少计算开销，而 RC 则利用 3DGS 的颜色积分过程来降低密集光栅化计算的频率。结合这些技术，我们提出了一种加速器架构 LuminCore，以进一步加速缓存查找并解决光栅化中的基本低效率问题。我们表明，Lumina 相对于移动 Volta GPU 实现了 4.5 倍的速度提升和 5.3 倍的能耗降低，在合成和真实世界数据集上质量损失微乎其微（峰值信噪比降低 < 0.2 dB）。

title: ScaleRTL: Scaling LLMs with Reasoning Data and Test-Time Compute for Accurate RTL Code Generation
authors: Chenhui Deng, Yun-Da Tsai, Guan-Ting Liu, Zhongzhi Yu, Haoxing Ren
abstract:
Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled near-human
performance on software coding benchmarks, but their effectiveness in RTL code
generation remains limited due to the scarcity of high-quality training data.
While prior efforts have fine-tuned LLMs for RTL tasks, they do not
fundamentally overcome the data bottleneck and lack support for test-time
scaling due to their non-reasoning nature. In this work, we introduce ScaleRTL,
the first reasoning LLM for RTL coding that scales up both high-quality
reasoning data and test-time compute. Specifically, we curate a diverse set of
long chain-of-thought reasoning traces averaging 56K tokens each, resulting in
a dataset of 3.5B tokens that captures rich RTL knowledge. Fine-tuning a
general-purpose reasoning model on this corpus yields ScaleRTL that is capable
of deep RTL reasoning. Subsequently, we further enhance the performance of
ScaleRTL through a novel test-time scaling strategy that extends the reasoning
process via iteratively reflecting on and self-correcting previous reasoning
steps. Experimental results show that ScaleRTL achieves state-of-the-art
performance on VerilogEval and RTLLM, outperforming 18 competitive baselines by
up to 18.4% on VerilogEval and 12.7% on RTLLM.
zh_title: ScaleRTL：通过推理数据和测试时计算扩展LLM以实现精确的RTL代码生成
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使得它们在软件编码基准测试上取得了接近人类的表现，但由于高质量训练数据的稀缺，它们在RTL代码生成方面的有效性仍然有限。虽然之前的努力已经对LLM进行了RTL任务的微调，但它们并未从根本上克服数据瓶颈，并且由于其非推理性质，缺乏对测试时扩展的支持。在这项工作中，我们引入了ScaleRTL，这是第一个用于RTL编码的推理型LLM，它扩展了高质量的推理数据和测试时计算。具体来说，我们整理了一组多样化的长链式思考推理轨迹，平均每个56K token，形成一个包含3.5B token的数据集，捕获了丰富的RTL知识。通过对通用推理模型进行此语料库的微调，得到了能够进行深度RTL推理的ScaleRTL。随后，我们通过一种新颖的测试时扩展策略进一步增强了ScaleRTL的性能，该策略通过迭代反思和自我纠正先前的推理步骤来扩展推理过程。实验结果表明，ScaleRTL在VerilogEval和RTLLM上取得了最先进的性能，在VerilogEval上比18个有竞争力的基线高出18.4%，在RTLLM上高出12.7%。
tldr: ScaleRTL是一个用于RTL代码生成的推理型LLM，通过高质量推理数据和测试时计算的扩展，在VerilogEval和RTLLM上实现了最先进的性能。

title: Preprocessing Methods for Memristive Reservoir Computing for Image Recognition
authors: Rishona Daniels, Duna Wattad, Ronny Ronen, David Saad, Shahar Kvatinsky
abstract:
Reservoir computing (RC) has attracted attention as an efficient recurrent
neural network architecture due to its simplified training, requiring only its
last perceptron readout layer to be trained. When implemented with memristors,
RC systems benefit from their dynamic properties, which make them ideal for
reservoir construction. However, achieving high performance in memristor-based
RC remains challenging, as it critically depends on the input preprocessing
method and reservoir size. Despite growing interest, a comprehensive evaluation
that quantifies the impact of these factors is still lacking. This paper
systematically compares various preprocessing methods for memristive RC
systems, assessing their effects on accuracy and energy consumption. We also
propose a parity-based preprocessing method that improves accuracy by 2-6%
while requiring only a modest increase in device count compared to other
methods. Our findings highlight the importance of informed preprocessing
strategies to improve the efficiency and scalability of memristive RC systems.

zh_title: 忆阻器储层计算用于图像识别的预处理方法
translation: 储层计算（RC）作为一种高效的循环神经网络架构，因其简化的训练（仅需训练其最后一个感知器读出层）而备受关注。当使用忆阻器实现时，RC 系统受益于其动态特性，这使得它们成为储层构建的理想选择。然而，在基于忆忆阻器的 RC 中实现高性能仍然具有挑战性，因为它关键取决于输入预处理方法和储层大小。尽管兴趣日益增长，但仍缺乏量化这些因素影响的全面评估。本文系统地比较了忆阻器 RC 系统中的各种预处理方法，评估它们对准确性和能耗的影响。我们还提出了一种基于奇偶校验的预处理方法，与其它方法相比，该方法将准确性提高了 2-6%，同时仅需适度增加器件数量。我们的研究结果强调了明智的预处理策略对于提高忆阻器 RC 系统效率和可扩展性的重要性。
tldr: 本文系统比较了忆阻器储层计算的预处理方法，并提出了一种新的基于奇偶校验的预处理方法，提高了图像识别的准确性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文在忆阻器储层计算领域具有重要意义，因为它不仅系统地评估了不同的预处理方法，还提出了一种有效的新方法来提高性能。其创新点在于提出了一种基于奇偶校验的预处理方法，这对于提升忆阻器RC在图像识别任务中的准确性和能效具有实际价值。该研究为未来设计和优化忆阻器RC系统提供了重要的指导。
motivation: 忆阻器储层计算在实现高性能时面临挑战，其性能关键取决于输入预处理方法和储层大小，目前缺乏对这些因素影响的全面评估。
method: 本文系统地比较了忆阻器储层计算系统中的各种预处理方法，评估它们对准确性和能耗的影响。同时，提出了一种基于奇偶校验的预处理方法。
results: 本文提出的基于奇偶校验的预处理方法可以将准确性提高2-6%，同时与其它方法相比，仅需适度增加器件数量。研究结果强调了明智的预处理策略对于提高忆阻器储层计算系统效率和可扩展性的重要性。
conclusion: 明智的预处理策略对于提高忆阻器储层计算系统的效率和可扩展性至关重要。

title: RETENTION: Resource-Efficient Tree-Based Ensemble Model Acceleration with Content-Addressable Memory
authors: Yi-Chun Liao, Chieh-Lin Tsai, Yuan-Hao Chang, Camélia Slimani, Jalil Boukhobza, Tei-Wei Kuo
abstract:
Although deep learning has demonstrated remarkable capabilities in learning
from unstructured data, modern tree-based ensemble models remain superior in
extracting relevant information and learning from structured datasets. While
several efforts have been made to accelerate tree-based models, the inherent
characteristics of the models pose significant challenges for conventional
accelerators. Recent research leveraging content-addressable memory (CAM)
offers a promising solution for accelerating tree-based models, yet existing
designs suffer from excessive memory consumption and low utilization. This work
addresses these challenges by introducing RETENTION, an end-to-end framework
that significantly reduces CAM capacity requirement for tree-based model
inference. We propose an iterative pruning algorithm with a novel pruning
criterion tailored for bagging-based models (e.g., Random Forest), which
minimizes model complexity while ensuring controlled accuracy degradation.
Additionally, we present a tree mapping scheme that incorporates two innovative
data placement strategies to alleviate the memory redundancy caused by the
widespread use of don't care states in CAM. Experimental results show that
implementing the tree mapping scheme alone achieves $1.46\times$ to $21.30
\times$ better space efficiency, while the full RETENTION framework yields
$4.35\times$ to $207.12\times$ improvement with less than 3% accuracy loss.
These results demonstrate that RETENTION is highly effective in reducing CAM
capacity requirement, providing a resource-efficient direction for tree-based
model acceleration.

zh_title: RETENTION: 基于内容可寻址存储器的资源高效树形集成模型加速
translation: 尽管深度学习在从非结构化数据中学习方面表现出卓越的能力，但现代树形集成模型在提取相关信息和从结构化数据集中学习方面仍然更胜一筹。虽然已经做出了一些努力来加速树形模型，但模型固有的特性给传统加速器带来了重大挑战。最近利用内容可寻址存储器（CAM）的研究为加速树形模型提供了一个有前景的解决方案，但现有设计存在内存消耗过大和利用率低的问题。这项工作通过引入RETENTION来解决这些挑战，RETENTION是一个端到端框架，显著降低了树形模型推理对CAM容量的需求。我们提出了一种迭代剪枝算法，该算法采用一种专为基于bagging的模型（例如随机森林）量身定制的新颖剪枝标准，从而在确保可控精度下降的同时最小化模型复杂性。此外，我们提出了一种树映射方案，该方案结合了两种创新的数据放置策略，以减轻CAM中广泛使用“不关心”状态导致的内存冗余。实验结果表明，仅实施树映射方案即可实现1.46倍至21.30倍的空间效率提升，而完整的RETENTION框架则可在精度损失小于3%的情况下实现4.35倍至207.12倍的改进。这些结果表明，RETENTION在降低CAM容量需求方面非常有效，为树形模型加速提供了一个资源高效的方向。
tldr: RETENTION是一个端到端框架，通过迭代剪枝算法和创新的树映射方案，显著减少了基于内容可寻址存储器（CAM）的树形集成模型推理所需的CAM容量，实现了高空间效率和低精度损失。
ai_comments: RETENTION的创新性在于将模型剪枝与针对CAM特性的树映射方案相结合，有效解决了CAM在加速树形模型时面临的内存效率瓶颈。这对于在资源受限的环境中部署高性能树形模型具有重要意义，提供了一种实用且高效的硬件加速路径。
motivation: 尽管深度学习在非结构化数据方面表现出色，但现代树形集成模型在处理结构化数据集方面仍具有优势。然而，现有加速树形模型的方法面临挑战，尤其是利用内容可寻址存储器（CAM）的方案存在内存消耗过大和利用率低的问题。
method: 本文提出了RETENTION框架，旨在显著降低树形模型推理对CAM容量的需求。该框架包括：1. 一种针对bagging-based模型（如随机森林）的迭代剪枝算法，该算法采用新颖的剪枝标准，以最小化模型复杂性并确保可控的精度下降。2. 一种树映射方案，该方案结合了两种创新的数据放置策略，以减轻CAM中广泛使用“不关心”状态导致的内存冗余。
results: 实验结果表明，仅实施树映射方案即可实现1.46倍至21.30倍的空间效率提升；而完整的RETENTION框架则可实现4.35倍至207.12倍的改进，且精度损失小于3%。
conclusion: RETENTION在降低CAM容量需求方面非常有效，为树形模型加速提供了一个资源高效的方向。

title: Zero-Trust Mobility-Aware Authentication Framework for Secure Vehicular Fog Computing Networks
authors: Taimoor Ahmad
abstract:
Vehicular Fog Computing (VFC) is a promising paradigm to meet the low-latency
and high-bandwidth demands of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS).
However, dynamic vehicle mobility and diverse trust boundaries introduce
critical security challenges. This paper presents a novel Zero-Trust
Mobility-Aware Authentication Framework (ZTMAF) for secure communication in VFC
networks. The framework employs context-aware authentication with lightweight
cryptographic primitives, a decentralized trust evaluation system, and fog
node-assisted session validation to combat spoofing, replay, and impersonation
attacks. Simulation results on NS-3 and SUMO demonstrate improved
authentication latency, reduced computational overhead, and better scalability
compared to traditional PKI and blockchain-based models. Our findings suggest
that ZTMAF is effective for secure, real-time V2X interactions under
adversarial and mobility-variant scenarios.
zh_title: 零信任移动感知认证框架，用于安全的车载雾计算网络
translation: 车载雾计算（VFC）是一种很有前景的范式，旨在满足智能交通系统（ITS）对低延迟和高带宽的需求。然而，动态的车辆移动性和多样的信任边界带来了关键的安全挑战。本文提出了一种新颖的零信任移动感知认证框架（ZTMAF），用于VFC网络中的安全通信。该框架采用上下文感知认证与轻量级加密原语、去中心化信任评估系统以及雾节点辅助会话验证，以对抗欺骗、重放和冒充攻击。在NS-3和SUMO上的仿真结果表明，与传统的PKI和基于区块链的模型相比，该框架在认证延迟、计算开销和可伸缩性方面均有所改善。我们的研究结果表明，ZTMAF在对抗性和移动多变场景下，对于安全的实时V2X交互是有效的。
tldr: 针对车载雾计算（VFC）网络中的安全挑战，本文提出了一种零信任移动感知认证框架（ZTMAF），通过轻量级加密、去中心化信任评估和雾节点辅助会话验证，有效提升了认证性能和安全性。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的零信任方法来解决VFC中的移动性和信任边界安全问题，通过结合多种技术手段，有效提升了车载通信的安全性。其轻量级加密和去中心化信任评估的设计有助于在资源受限的车载环境中实现高效认证。仿真结果也验证了其性能优势，对于未来安全V2X通信具有重要的参考价值。

method: 本文提出了一种新颖的零信任移动感知认证框架（ZTMAF），用于VFC网络中的安全通信。该框架采用上下文感知认证与轻量级加密原语、去中心化信任评估系统以及雾节点辅助会话验证，以对抗欺骗、重放和冒充攻击。研究通过NS-3和SUMO进行仿真。
results: 仿真结果表明，与传统的PKI和基于区块链的模型相比，ZTMAF在认证延迟、计算开销和可伸缩性方面均有所改善。
conclusion: 研究结果表明，ZTMAF在对抗性和移动多变场景下，对于安全的实时V2X交互是有效的。

title: AI-Driven Dynamic Firewall Optimization Using Reinforcement Learning for Anomaly Detection and Prevention
authors: Taimoor Ahmad
abstract:
The growing complexity of cyber threats has rendered static firewalls
increasingly ineffective for dynamic, real-time intrusion prevention. This
paper proposes a novel AI-driven dynamic firewall optimization framework that
leverages deep reinforcement learning (DRL) to autonomously adapt and update
firewall rules in response to evolving network threats. Our system employs a
Markov Decision Process (MDP) formulation, where the RL agent observes network
states, detects anomalies using a hybrid LSTM-CNN model, and dynamically
modifies firewall configurations to mitigate risks. We train and evaluate our
framework on the NSL-KDD and CIC-IDS2017 datasets using a simulated
software-defined network environment. Results demonstrate significant
improvements in detection accuracy, false positive reduction, and rule update
latency when compared to traditional signature- and behavior-based firewalls.
The proposed method provides a scalable, autonomous solution for enhancing
network resilience against complex attack vectors in both enterprise and
critical infrastructure settings.
zh_title: 基于强化学习的AI驱动动态防火墙优化，用于异常检测和预防
translation: 网络威胁日益复杂，使得静态防火墙在动态、实时入侵防御方面越来越无效。本文提出了一种新颖的AI驱动动态防火墙优化框架，该框架利用深度强化学习（DRL）来自主适应和更新防火墙规则，以应对不断演变的网络威胁。我们的系统采用马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）公式，其中RL代理观察网络状态，使用混合LSTM-CNN模型检测异常，并动态修改防火墙配置以降低风险。我们在NSL-KDD和CIC-IDS2017数据集上，使用模拟软件定义网络环境对我们的框架进行了训练和评估。结果表明，与传统的基于签名和基于行为的防火墙相比，在检测准确性、误报减少和规则更新延迟方面有显著改进。所提出的方法提供了一种可扩展、自主的解决方案，用于增强企业和关键基础设施设置中网络对复杂攻击向量的弹性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种AI驱动的动态防火墙优化框架，利用深度强化学习自动调整防火墙规则，以应对不断演变的网络威胁，并在检测准确性、误报率和规则更新延迟方面优于传统防火墙。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于将深度强化学习应用于防火墙规则的动态优化，使其能够自主适应不断变化的网络威胁。其重要性在于提供了一种可扩展的、实时的网络安全解决方案，显著提高了异常检测的准确性并降低了误报率，对于企业和关键基础设施的网络弹性具有重要意义。
motivation: 日益复杂的网络威胁使得静态防火墙在动态、实时入侵防御方面越来越无效。
method: 本文提出了一个新颖的AI驱动动态防火墙优化框架，该框架利用深度强化学习（DRL）来自主适应和更新防火墙规则。该系统采用马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）公式，其中RL代理观察网络状态，使用混合LSTM-CNN模型检测异常，并动态修改防火墙配置以降低风险。该框架在NSL-KDD和CIC-IDS2017数据集上，使用模拟软件定义网络环境进行了训练和评估。
results: 结果表明，与传统的基于签名和基于行为的防火墙相比，在检测准确性、误报减少和规则更新延迟方面有显著改进。
conclusion: 所提出的方法提供了一种可扩展、自主的解决方案，用于增强企业和关键基础设施设置中网络对复杂攻击向量的弹性。

title: A New Representation of Binary Sequences by means of Boolean Functions
authors: S. D. Cardell, A. Fuúter-Sabater, V. Requena, M. Beltrá
abstract:
Boolean functions and binary sequences are main tools used in cryptography.
In this work, we introduce a new bijection between the set of Boolean functions
and the set of binary sequences with period a power of two. We establish a
connection between them which allows us to study some properties of Boolean
functions through binary sequences and vice versa. Then, we define a new
representation of sequences, based on Boolean functions and derived from the
algebraic normal form, named reverse-ANF. Next, we study the relation between
such a representation and other representations of Boolean functions as well as
between such a representation and the binary sequences. Finally, we analyse the
generalized self-shrinking sequences in terms of Boolean functions and some of
their properties using the different representations.
zh_title: 二进制序列的一种布尔函数新表示法
translation: 布尔函数和二进制序列是密码学中使用的主要工具。在这项工作中，我们引入了布尔函数集与周期为2的幂的二进制序列集之间的一种新双射。我们建立了它们之间的联系，这使我们能够通过二进制序列研究布尔函数的某些性质，反之亦然。然后，我们定义了一种新的序列表示法，基于布尔函数并源自代数范式，名为reverse-ANF。接下来，我们研究了这种表示法与布尔函数的其他表示法之间的关系，以及这种表示法与二进制序列之间的关系。最后，我们利用布尔函数和不同的表示法分析了广义自收缩序列及其某些性质。
tldr: 论文介绍了一种布尔函数和二进制序列之间的新双射，并定义了基于布尔函数的reverse-ANF表示法，用于研究它们之间的关系和性质。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过引入布尔函数与二进制序列之间的新双射和reverse-ANF表示法，为研究这两者之间的关系提供了新的视角和工具，可能对密码学等领域的基础理论研究有所贡献。
motivation: 布尔函数和二进制序列是密码学中的主要工具，研究它们之间的关系和性质具有重要意义。
method: 1. 引入布尔函数集与周期为2的幂的二进制序列集之间的新双射。2. 建立两者之间的联系，以便通过二进制序列研究布尔函数的性质，反之亦然。3. 定义一种新的序列表示法，称为reverse-ANF，它基于布尔函数并源自代数范式。4. 研究这种表示法与其他布尔函数表示法以及与二进制序列之间的关系。5. 利用布尔函数和不同的表示法分析广义自收缩序列及其性质。

title: A MARL-based Approach for Easing MAS Organization Engineering
authors: Julien Soulé, Jean-Paul Jamont, Michel Occello, Louis-Marie Traonouez, Paul Théron
abstract:
Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have been successfully applied in industry for
their ability to address complex, distributed problems, especially in IoT-based
systems. Their efficiency in achieving given objectives and meeting design
requirements is strongly dependent on the MAS organization during the
engineering process of an application-specific MAS. To design a MAS that can
achieve given goals, available methods rely on the designer's knowledge of the
deployment environment. However, high complexity and low readability in some
deployment environments make the application of these methods to be costly or
raise safety concerns. In order to ease the MAS organization design regarding
those concerns, we introduce an original Assisted MAS Organization Engineering
Approach (AOMEA). AOMEA relies on combining a Multi-Agent Reinforcement
Learning (MARL) process with an organizational model to suggest relevant
organizational specifications to help in MAS engineering.
zh_title: 基于MARL的MAS组织工程简化方法
translation: 多智能体系统（MAS）因其解决复杂分布式问题的能力，尤其是在基于物联网的系统中，已成功应用于工业领域。它们在实现既定目标和满足设计要求方面的效率，在特定应用MAS的工程过程中，强烈依赖于MAS的组织。为了设计一个能够实现既定目标的MAS，现有方法依赖于设计者对部署环境的了解。然而，某些部署环境的高度复杂性和低可读性使得这些方法的应用成本高昂或引发安全问题。为了缓解这些问题下的MAS组织设计，我们引入了一种原创的辅助MAS组织工程方法（AOMEA）。AOMEA依赖于将多智能体强化学习（MARL）过程与组织模型相结合，以建议相关的组织规范，从而辅助MAS工程。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多智能体强化学习（MARL）的方法，用于简化多智能体系统（MAS）的组织工程，以解决现有方法在复杂部署环境中成本高、可读性差的问题。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种结合MARL和组织模型的新颖方法来解决MAS组织工程中的挑战，特别是针对复杂环境下的设计成本和安全问题。其创新点在于利用强化学习的自适应能力来辅助MAS的设计，有望提高效率并降低风险。
motivation: 多智能体系统（MAS）的组织设计效率受部署环境影响，现有方法依赖设计者知识，但在复杂或低可读性环境中应用成本高昂或存在安全隐患。因此，需要一种方法来简化MAS组织设计。
method: 本文提出了一种名为辅助MAS组织工程方法（AOMEA）的原创方法。AOMEA结合了多智能体强化学习（MARL）过程与组织模型，以建议相关的组织规范，从而辅助MAS工程。

title: Sequence Modeling for N-Agent Ad Hoc Teamwork
authors: Caroline Wang, Di Yang Shi, Elad Liebman, Ishan Durugkar, Arrasy Rahman, Peter Stone
abstract:
N-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT) is a newly introduced challenge in multi-agent
reinforcement learning, where controlled subteams of varying sizes must
dynamically collaborate with varying numbers and types of unknown teammates
without pre-coordination. The existing learning algorithm (POAM) considers only
independent learning for its flexibility in dealing with a changing number of
agents. However, independent learning fails to fully capture the inter-agent
dynamics essential for effective collaboration. Based on our observation that
transformers deal effectively with sequences with varying lengths and have been
shown to be highly effective for a variety of machine learning problems, this
work introduces a centralized, transformer-based method for N-agent ad hoc
teamwork. Our proposed approach incorporates historical observations and
actions of all controlled agents, enabling optimal responses to diverse and
unseen teammates in partially observable environments. Empirical evaluation on
a StarCraft II task demonstrates that MAT-NAHT outperforms POAM, achieving
superior sample efficiency and generalization, without auxiliary agent-modeling
objectives.
zh_title: N智能体特设团队的序列建模
translation: N智能体特设团队（NAHT）是多智能体强化学习中新引入的挑战，其中不同规模的受控子团队必须在没有预先协调的情况下，与数量和类型各异的未知队友动态协作。现有学习算法（POAM）仅考虑独立学习，以应对智能体数量变化的灵活性。然而，独立学习未能充分捕捉对于有效协作至关重要的智能体间动态。基于我们对Transformer能够有效处理变长序列并已在各种机器学习问题中被证明高效的观察，本研究引入了一种基于Transformer的集中式N智能体特设团队方法。我们提出的方法整合了所有受控智能体的历史观察和动作，从而能够在部分可观察环境中对多样化和未知队友做出最优响应。在StarCraft II任务上的实证评估表明，MAT-NAHT 优于 POAM，在没有辅助智能体建模目标的情况下，实现了卓越的样本效率和泛化能力。
tldr: 本文针对N智能体特设团队（NAHT）问题，提出了一种基于Transformer的集中式方法，通过捕获智能体间动态，显著优于现有方法，提升了样本效率和泛化能力。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入Transformer模型来解决N智能体特设团队中智能体间动态捕捉的挑战，其集中式方法和对历史信息的有效利用是创新点。该方法在没有辅助智能体建模目标的情况下，在样本效率和泛化能力上展现出显著优势，对多智能体强化学习领域特别是动态协作场景具有重要意义。
motivation: 多智能体强化学习中的N智能体特设团队（NAHT）是一个新挑战，现有学习算法（POAM）仅考虑独立学习，未能充分捕捉智能体间的动态，而这对于有效协作至关重要。
method: 本文引入了一种基于Transformer的集中式方法，该方法利用Transformer处理变长序列的能力，并整合了所有受控智能体的历史观察和动作，以在部分可观察环境中对多样化和未知队友做出最优响应。
results: 在StarCraft II任务上的实证评估表明，MAT-NAHT（所提出的方法）优于POAM，在没有辅助智能体建模目标的情况下，实现了卓越的样本效率和泛化能力。
conclusion: 基于Transformer的集中式方法能够有效处理N智能体特设团队问题，通过充分捕获智能体间的动态，显著提升了性能、样本效率和泛化能力。

title: A Red Teaming Roadmap Towards System-Level Safety
authors: Zifan Wang, Christina Q. Knight, Jeremy Kritz, Willow E. Primack, Julian Michael
abstract:
Large Language Model (LLM) safeguards, which implement request refusals, have
become a widely adopted mitigation strategy against misuse. At the intersection
of adversarial machine learning and AI safety, safeguard red teaming has
effectively identified critical vulnerabilities in state-of-the-art
refusal-trained LLMs. However, in our view the many conference submissions on
LLM red teaming do not, in aggregate, prioritize the right research problems.
First, testing against clear product safety specifications should take a higher
priority than abstract social biases or ethical principles. Second, red teaming
should prioritize realistic threat models that represent the expanding risk
landscape and what real attackers might do. Finally, we contend that
system-level safety is a necessary step to move red teaming research forward,
as AI models present new threats as well as affordances for threat mitigation
(e.g., detection and banning of malicious users) once placed in a deployment
context. Adopting these priorities will be necessary in order for red teaming
research to adequately address the slate of new threats that rapid AI advances
present today and will present in the very near future.
zh_title: 迈向系统级安全的红队路线图
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的安全防护措施，即实施请求拒绝，已成为一种广泛采用的防滥用缓解策略。在对抗性机器学习和人工智能安全的交叉领域，安全防护红队测试已有效识别出最先进的经过拒绝训练的LLM中的关键漏洞。然而，在我们看来，许多关于LLM红队测试的会议投稿，总体而言，并未优先考虑正确的研究问题。首先，针对明确的产品安全规范进行测试应比抽象的社会偏见或道德原则具有更高的优先级。其次，红队测试应优先考虑代表不断扩展的风险格局和真实攻击者可能行为的现实威胁模型。最后，我们认为系统级安全是推动红队研究向前发展的必要一步，因为人工智能模型一旦部署，既会带来新的威胁，也会提供威胁缓解的能力（例如，检测和禁止恶意用户）。采纳这些优先级对于红队研究充分应对当前和在不久的将来人工智能快速发展所带来的新威胁是必要的。
tldr: 当前LLM红队测试需将重点转向产品安全、真实威胁和系统级安全，以应对AI快速发展带来的新威胁。
ai_comments: 这篇论文意义重大，因为它批判性地评估了当前大型语言模型红队测试的现状，并提出了一份实用且具有前瞻性的路线图。它对系统级安全和现实威胁模型的强调突出了人工智能安全研究中亟需的关键转变，即从孤立的模型测试转向考虑更广泛的部署环境。
motivation: 作者认为当前大型语言模型（LLM）的红队研究未能优先考虑正确的问题，特别是在明确的产品安全规范、真实的威胁模型和系统级安全方面缺乏关注。
method: 该论文提出了一份红队研究路线图，优先考虑：1）针对明确的产品安全规范进行测试；2）关注真实的威胁模型；3）转向系统级安全。
results: 该论文提出了一套修订后的大型语言模型红队测试优先级，认为采纳这些优先级对于充分应对人工智能快速发展带来的新威胁是必要的。
conclusion: 采纳所提出的优先级（产品安全、真实威胁模型和系统级安全）对于红队研究有效应对当前和未来与人工智能相关的威胁至关重要。

title: Learning to Recover: Dynamic Reward Shaping with Wheel-Leg Coordination for Fallen Robots
authors: Boyuan Deng, Luca Rossini, Jin Wang, Weijie Wang, Nikolaos Tsagarakis
abstract:
Adaptive recovery from fall incidents are essential skills for the practical
deployment of wheeled-legged robots, which uniquely combine the agility of legs
with the speed of wheels for rapid recovery. However, traditional methods
relying on preplanned recovery motions, simplified dynamics or sparse rewards
often fail to produce robust recovery policies. This paper presents a
learning-based framework integrating Episode-based Dynamic Reward Shaping and
curriculum learning, which dynamically balances exploration of diverse recovery
maneuvers with precise posture refinement. An asymmetric actor-critic
architecture accelerates training by leveraging privileged information in
simulation, while noise-injected observations enhance robustness against
uncertainties. We further demonstrate that synergistic wheel-leg coordination
reduces joint torque consumption by 15.8% and 26.2% and improves stabilization
through energy transfer mechanisms. Extensive evaluations on two distinct
quadruped platforms achieve recovery success rates up to 99.1% and 97.8%
without platform-specific tuning. The supplementary material is available at
https://boyuandeng.github.io/L2R-WheelLegCoordination/
zh_title: 学习恢复：面向摔倒机器人的轮腿协调动态奖励塑形
translation:
学习恢复：面向摔倒机器人的轮腿协调动态奖励塑形

从摔倒事故中自适应恢复是轮腿机器人实际部署的必备技能，它独特地结合了腿的敏捷性和轮子的速度以实现快速恢复。然而，依赖预先规划的恢复动作、简化动力学或稀疏奖励的传统方法往往无法产生鲁棒的恢复策略。本文提出了一个基于学习的框架，整合了基于回合的动态奖励塑形和课程学习，动态平衡了多样化恢复动作的探索与精确姿态调整。非对称的Actor-Critic架构通过利用仿真中的特权信息加速训练，同时注入噪声的观测增强了对不确定性的鲁棒性。我们进一步证明，协同的轮腿协调将关节扭矩消耗分别降低了15.8%和26.2%，并通过能量传递机制提高了稳定性。在两个不同的四足机器人平台上进行的广泛评估实现了高达99.1%和97.8%的恢复成功率，且无需针对特定平台进行调整。补充材料可在https://boyuandeng.github.io/L2R-WheelLegCoordination/ 获取。
tldr: 本文提出一个基于学习的框架，结合动态奖励塑形和课程学习，使轮腿机器人在摔倒后能高效、鲁棒地恢复，并通过轮腿协调显著降低能耗并提高稳定性，成功率高达99.1%。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于结合了动态奖励塑形和课程学习来解决轮腿机器人摔倒恢复的挑战，并通过非对称Actor-Critic架构和噪声注入观测提高了学习效率和策略鲁棒性。特别值得注意的是，它强调了轮腿协调在节能和稳定方面的优势，并在多个平台上验证了其泛化能力，对机器人实际应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 轮腿机器人在实际部署中，从摔倒事故中自适应恢复是必不可少的技能。然而，传统方法依赖预先规划的恢复动作、简化的动力学或稀疏奖励，往往无法产生鲁棒的恢复策略。
method: 本文提出一个基于学习的框架，整合了基于回合的动态奖励塑形和课程学习，动态平衡了多样化恢复动作的探索与精确姿态调整。采用非对称Actor-Critic架构，利用仿真中的特权信息加速训练。通过注入噪声的观测增强了对不确定性的鲁棒性。研究进一步展示了协同轮腿协调机制。
results: 协同轮腿协调将关节扭矩消耗分别降低了15.8%和26.2%，并通过能量传递机制提高了稳定性。在两个不同的四足机器人平台上进行了广泛评估，恢复成功率分别达到99.1%和97.8%，且无需针对特定平台进行调整。
conclusion: 本文提出的学习框架，结合动态奖励塑形和轮腿协调，显著提高了轮腿机器人在摔倒后的恢复能力和效率，展现出优异的泛化性和鲁棒性。

title: Survey of LLM Agent Communication with MCP: A Software Design Pattern Centric Review
authors: Anjana Sarkar, Soumyendu Sarkar
abstract:
This survey investigates how classical software design patterns can enhance
the reliability and scalability of communication in Large Language Model
(LLM)-driven agentic AI systems, focusing particularly on the Model Context
Protocol (MCP). It examines the foundational architectures of LLM-based agents
and their evolution from isolated operation to sophisticated, multi-agent
collaboration, addressing key communication hurdles that arise in this
transition. The study revisits well-established patterns, including Mediator,
Observer, Publish-Subscribe, and Broker, and analyzes their relevance in
structuring agent interactions within MCP-compliant frameworks. To clarify
these dynamics, the article provides conceptual schematics and formal models
that map out communication pathways and optimize data flow. It further explores
architectural variations suited to different degrees of agent autonomy and
system complexity. Real-world applications in domains such as real-time
financial processing and investment banking are discussed, illustrating how
these patterns and MCP can meet specific operational demands. The article
concludes by outlining open challenges, potential security risks, and promising
directions for advancing robust, interoperable, and scalable multi-agent LLM
ecosystems.
zh_title: LLM智能体与MCP通信综述：以软件设计模式为中心的视角
translation: 本综述调查了经典软件设计模式如何增强大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体AI系统中通信的可靠性和可扩展性，特别关注模型上下文协议（MCP）。它审查了基于LLM的智能体的基础架构及其从独立操作到复杂多智能体协作的演变，解决了在此过渡中出现的关键通信障碍。本研究重新审视了成熟的模式，包括中介者、观察者、发布-订阅和代理，并分析了它们在符合MCP的框架中构建智能体交互的相关性。为了阐明这些动态，文章提供了概念示意图和形式模型，以映射通信路径并优化数据流。它进一步探讨了适用于不同智能体自主度和系统复杂度的架构变体。文中讨论了实时金融处理和投资银行等领域的实际应用，说明了这些模式和MCP如何满足特定的操作需求。文章最后概述了开放性挑战、潜在安全风险以及推进健壮、可互操作和可扩展的多智能体LLM生态系统的有前景方向。
tldr: 本综述探讨了经典软件设计模式如何通过模型上下文协议（MCP）增强大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体AI系统中通信的可靠性和可扩展性，并分析了其在多智能体协作中的应用和未来挑战。
ai_comments: 这篇综述的创新之处在于将传统的软件设计模式与新兴的LLM智能体通信相结合，特别是聚焦于MCP，为构建更可靠、可扩展的多智能体系统提供了实用的指导和理论框架。其重要性体现在为解决LLM智能体协作中的通信难题提供了系统性的解决方案，并指出了未来研究的方向，具有较高的理论和实践价值。
motivation: 本研究旨在探讨经典软件设计模式如何增强大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体AI系统中通信的可靠性和可扩展性，特别关注模型上下文协议（MCP），以解决多智能体协作中出现的关键通信障碍。
method: 本研究审查了基于LLM的智能体的基础架构及其从独立操作到复杂多智能体协作的演变。它重新审视了包括中介者、观察者、发布-订阅和代理在内的成熟设计模式，并分析了它们在符合MCP的框架中构建智能体交互的相关性。文章提供了概念示意图和形式模型以映射通信路径并优化数据流，并探讨了适用于不同智能体自主度和系统复杂度的架构变体。
results: 研究结果表明，经典软件设计模式（如中介者、观察者、发布-订阅和代理）能够有效增强LLM驱动的智能体AI系统中通信的可靠性和可扩展性。文章提供了概念示意图和形式模型，并讨论了这些模式和MCP在实时金融处理和投资银行等领域的实际应用，展示了它们如何满足特定的操作需求。
conclusion: 本研究总结了开放性挑战、潜在安全风险以及推进健壮、可互操作和可扩展的多智能体LLM生态系统的有前景方向。

title: Contextual Memory Intelligence -- A Foundational Paradigm for Human-AI Collaboration and Reflective Generative AI Systems
authors: Kristy Wedel
abstract:
A critical challenge remains unresolved as generative AI systems are quickly
implemented in various organizational settings. Despite significant advances in
memory components such as RAG, vector stores, and LLM agents, these systems
still have substantial memory limitations. Gen AI workflows rarely store or
reflect on the full context in which decisions are made. This leads to repeated
errors and a general lack of clarity. This paper introduces Contextual Memory
Intelligence (CMI) as a new foundational paradigm for building intelligent
systems. It repositions memory as an adaptive infrastructure necessary for
longitudinal coherence, explainability, and responsible decision-making rather
than passive data. Drawing on cognitive science, organizational theory,
human-computer interaction, and AI governance, CMI formalizes the structured
capture, inference, and regeneration of context as a fundamental system
capability. The Insight Layer is presented in this paper to operationalize this
vision. This modular architecture uses human-in-the-loop reflection, drift
detection, and rationale preservation to incorporate contextual memory into
systems. The paper argues that CMI allows systems to reason with data, history,
judgment, and changing context, thereby addressing a foundational blind spot in
current AI architectures and governance efforts. A framework for creating
intelligent systems that are effective, reflective, auditable, and socially
responsible is presented through CMI. This enhances human-AI collaboration,
generative AI design, and the resilience of the institutions.
zh_title: 情境记忆智能——人机协作和反思性生成式AI系统的基础范式
translation: 生成式AI系统在各种组织环境中迅速实施，但一个关键挑战仍未解决。尽管RAG、向量存储和LLM代理等记忆组件取得了显著进展，但这些系统仍然存在严重的记忆局限性。生成式AI工作流很少存储或反思决策的完整上下文。这导致重复错误和普遍缺乏清晰度。本文引入情境记忆智能（CMI）作为构建智能系统的新基础范式。它将记忆重新定位为纵向一致性、可解释性和负责任决策所需的自适应基础设施，而不仅仅是被动数据。CMI借鉴认知科学、组织理论、人机交互和AI治理，将上下文的结构化捕获、推断和再生形式化为一种基本系统能力。本文提出了“洞察层”来操作化这一愿景。这种模块化架构利用人机循环反思、漂移检测和理由保留来将情境记忆整合到系统中。本文认为CMI允许系统利用数据、历史、判断和不断变化的上下文进行推理，从而解决了当前AI架构和治理工作中的一个基础盲点。通过CMI，本文提出了一个用于创建有效、反思、可审计和社会负责任的智能系统的框架。这将增强人机协作、生成式AI设计以及机构的韧性。
tldr: 本文提出情境记忆智能（CMI）作为一种新的基础范式，旨在解决当前生成式AI系统在记忆方面的局限性，通过结构化捕获、推断和再生上下文来增强系统能力，实现更有效的反思、可审计和负责任的AI系统。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一个重要的概念，即情境记忆智能（CMI），它超越了传统记忆组件的局限性，将记忆视为一种主动的、自适应的基础设施。其创新之处在于将认知科学、组织理论和AI治理等多学科知识整合，并提出了“洞察层”这一具体操作框架。这对于提升生成式AI系统的长期一致性、可解释性和负责任的决策能力具有重要意义，尤其是在强调人机协作和AI伦理的背景下，该范式有望解决当前AI应用中的核心痛点。
motivation: 尽管RAG、向量存储和LLM代理等记忆组件取得了显著进展，但生成式AI系统仍存在严重的记忆局限性，工作流很少存储或反思决策的完整上下文，导致重复错误和缺乏清晰度。
method: 本文引入情境记忆智能（CMI）作为构建智能系统的新基础范式。CMI将记忆重新定位为纵向一致性、可解释性和负责任决策所需的自适应基础设施。它借鉴认知科学、组织理论、人机交互和AI治理，将上下文的结构化捕获、推断和再生形式化为一种基本系统能力。论文还提出了“洞察层”（Insight Layer）来操作化这一愿景，该模块化架构利用人机循环反思、漂移检测和理由保留来将情境记忆整合到系统中。
results: CMI使系统能够利用数据、历史、判断和不断变化的上下文进行推理，从而解决了当前AI架构和治理工作中的一个基础盲点。通过CMI，本文提出了一个用于创建有效、反思、可审计和社会负责任的智能系统的框架。
conclusion: 本文认为情境记忆智能（CMI）允许系统利用数据、历史、判断和不断变化的上下文进行推理，从而解决了当前AI架构和治理工作中的一个基础盲点。CMI提出了一个用于创建有效、反思、可审计和社会负责任的智能系统的框架，这将增强人机协作、生成式AI设计以及机构的韧性。

title: Can ChatGPT Perform Image Splicing Detection? A Preliminary Study
authors: Souradip Nath
abstract:
Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) like GPT-4V are capable of reasoning
across text and image modalities, showing promise in a variety of complex
vision-language tasks. In this preliminary study, we investigate the
out-of-the-box capabilities of GPT-4V in the domain of image forensics,
specifically, in detecting image splicing manipulations. Without any
task-specific fine-tuning, we evaluate GPT-4V using three prompting strategies:
Zero-Shot (ZS), Few-Shot (FS), and Chain-of-Thought (CoT), applied over a
curated subset of the CASIA v2.0 splicing dataset.
  Our results show that GPT-4V achieves competitive detection performance in
zero-shot settings (more than 85% accuracy), with CoT prompting yielding the
most balanced trade-off across authentic and spliced images. Qualitative
analysis further reveals that the model not only detects low-level visual
artifacts but also draws upon real-world contextual knowledge such as object
scale, semantic consistency, and architectural facts, to identify implausible
composites. While GPT-4V lags behind specialized state-of-the-art splicing
detection models, its generalizability, interpretability, and encyclopedic
reasoning highlight its potential as a flexible tool in image forensics.
zh_title: ChatGPT能进行图像拼接检测吗？一项初步研究
translation: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）如GPT-4V能够跨文本和图像模态进行推理，在各种复杂的视觉-语言任务中显示出前景。在这项初步研究中，我们调查了GPT-4V在图像取证领域，特别是检测图像拼接篡改方面的即用能力。在没有任何任务特定微调的情况下，我们使用三种提示策略：零样本（ZS）、少样本（FS）和思维链（CoT），对GPT-4V进行了评估，这些策略应用于CASIA v2.0拼接数据集的精选子集。\n我们的结果显示，GPT-4V在零样本设置下取得了有竞争力的检测性能（超过85%的准确率），其中思维链提示在真实图像和拼接图像之间取得了最平衡的权衡。定性分析进一步揭示，该模型不仅能检测低级视觉伪影，还能利用现实世界上下文知识，如物体比例、语义一致性和建筑事实，来识别不合理的合成图像。尽管GPT-4V落后于专门的最新拼接检测模型，但其泛化性、可解释性和百科全书式推理能力突显了其作为图像取证领域灵活工具的潜力。
tldr: 本研究探讨了GPT-4V在未经特定任务微调的情况下，在图像拼接检测方面的即用能力，结果显示其在零样本设置下表现良好（超过85%准确率），并能利用上下文知识进行推理，显示出其在图像取证领域的潜力。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于，它探索了将通用型多模态大型语言模型（GPT-4V）应用于特定图像取证任务（图像拼接检测）的潜力，且未进行任何微调。这展示了通用模型在特定领域出人意料的即用能力。模型不仅能识别视觉伪影，还能利用现实世界上下文知识进行推理，这尤其具有洞察力。尽管其性能尚未超越最先进的专业模型，但其泛化性和可解释性是显著的优势，预示着未来在图像取证领域作为灵活工具的广阔前景。
motivation: 探索多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）如GPT-4V在图像取证领域，特别是图像拼接检测方面的即用能力，且不进行任何任务特定的微调。
method: 研究者评估了GPT-4V在CASIA v2.0拼接数据集的精选子集上的性能。评估采用了三种提示策略：零样本（ZS）、少样本（FS）和思维链（CoT）。
results: GPT-4V在零样本设置下取得了有竞争力的检测性能（超过85%的准确率）。思维链提示在真实图像和拼接图像之间取得了最平衡的权衡。定性分析表明模型不仅能检测低级视觉伪影，还能利用现实世界上下文知识（如物体比例、语义一致性和建筑事实）来识别不合理的合成图像。
conclusion: 尽管GPT-4V的性能落后于专门的SOTA拼接检测模型，但其泛化性、可解释性和百科全书式推理能力突显了其作为图像取证领域灵活工具的潜力。

title: The Artificial Benchmark for Community Detection with Outliers and Overlapping Communities (ABCD+$o^2$)
authors: Jordan Barrett, Ryan DeWolfe, Bogumił Kamiński, Paweł Prałat, Aaron Smith, François Théberge
abstract:
The Artificial Benchmark for Community Detection (ABCD) graph is a random
graph model with community structure and power-law distribution for both
degrees and community sizes. The model generates graphs similar to the
well-known LFR model but it is faster, more interpretable, and can be
investigated analytically. In this paper, we use the underlying ingredients of
the ABCD model, and its generalization to include outliers (ABCD+$o$), and
introduce another variant that allows for overlapping communities, ABCD+$o^2$.
zh_title: 具有异常值和重叠社区的社区检测人工基准 (ABCD+$o^2$)
translation: 人工社区检测基准（ABCD）图是一个具有社区结构和度数与社区大小均服从幂律分布的随机图模型。该模型生成的图与著名的LFR模型相似，但它更快、更具可解释性，并且可以进行分析研究。在本文中，我们利用ABCD模型及其包含异常值（ABCD+$o$）的泛化，并引入了另一个允许重叠社区的变体，即ABCD+$o^2$。
tldr: 引入了ABCD模型的一个新变体ABCD+$o^2$，用于社区检测，该模型包含异常值和重叠社区。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于扩展了现有的ABCD基准模型，使其能够处理社区检测中更复杂的现实场景，即存在异常值和重叠社区的情况。这将为评估社区检测算法提供一个更强大和灵活的工具。
motivation: 现有的ABCD模型及其包含异常值的变体ABCD+$o$需要进一步扩展以支持重叠社区，以提供更全面的社区检测基准。
method: 本文利用ABCD模型及其包含异常值（ABCD+$o$）的泛化，引入了另一个允许重叠社区的变体，即ABCD+$o^2$。
results: 引入了ABCD+$o^2$模型，该模型是一个用于社区检测的人工基准，支持异常值和重叠社区。
conclusion: ABCD+$o^2$模型被引入作为一种新的社区检测基准，能够处理异常值和重叠社区。

title: A Path to Loving
authors: John Beverley, Regina Hurley
abstract:
This work lays the foundations for a rigorous ontological characterization of
love, addressing its philosophical complexity and scientific relevance, with
particular emphasis on psychology and sociology, as well as highlighting ways
in which such characterization enhances relevant AI based applications. The
position defended here is that love is best understood as a concatenation of
passive sensations (e.g., emotional arousal) and active evaluative judgments
(e.g., perceiving the beloved as valuable), in the interest of balancing the
involuntary aspects of love with its rational accountability. To provide a
structured foundation, the paper draws on Basic Formal Ontology (BFO) and other
applied ontological methods to differentiate various senses of love. This work
engages with objections to the understanding of love as concatenation,
particularly concerning the relationship between sensation and judgment. A
causal correlation model is defended, ensuring that the affective and cognitive
components are linked. By offering a precise and scalable ontological account,
this work lays the foundation for future interdisciplinary applications, making
love a subject of formal inquiry in ontology engineering, artificial
intelligence, and the sciences.
zh_title: 爱的路径
translation: 这项工作为爱的严格本体论表征奠定了基础，解决了其哲学复杂性和科学相关性，特别强调了心理学和社会学，并突出了这种表征如何增强相关的人工智能应用。本文所捍卫的立场是，爱最好被理解为被动感觉（例如，情感唤起）和主动评价判断（例如，将所爱之人视为有价值）的结合，旨在平衡爱的非自愿方面与其理性责任。为了提供一个结构化的基础，本文借鉴了基本形式本体论（BFO）和其他应用本体论方法来区分爱的各种意义。这项工作探讨了对将爱理解为连接的反对意见，特别是关于感觉和判断之间的关系。本文捍卫了一种因果关联模型，确保情感和认知成分是相互关联的。通过提供精确且可扩展的本体论描述，这项工作为未来的跨学科应用奠定了基础，使爱成为本体论工程、人工智能和科学中形式化探究的主题。
tldr: 本文为爱的本体论表征奠定了基础，将其理解为被动感觉和主动评价判断的结合，并利用本体论方法，旨在为未来的跨学科应用，特别是AI领域提供形式化探究。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将爱视为一个可以进行严格本体论分析的概念，并将其与AI应用联系起来。通过结合哲学、心理学、社会学和本体论方法，它为理解和形式化爱提供了一个新颖的视角。其重要性在于为未来在人工智能领域中更精确地模拟和应用爱提供了理论基础，可能推动情感智能和人机交互的发展。
motivation: 本文旨在对爱进行严格的本体论表征，解决其哲学复杂性和科学相关性，并强调这种表征如何增强相关的人工智能应用。
method: 本文利用基本形式本体论（BFO）和其他应用本体论方法来区分爱的各种意义。它将爱理解为被动感觉（如情感唤起）和主动评价判断（如将所爱之人视为有价值）的结合。同时，本文还捍卫了一种因果关联模型，以确保情感和认知成分的联系。
results: 本文提出并捍卫了将爱理解为被动感觉和主动评价判断的结合的立场，并提出了一个因果关联模型来连接情感和认知成分。它为未来的跨学科应用奠定了基础，使爱成为本体论工程、人工智能和科学中形式化探究的主题。
conclusion: 本文通过提供精确且可扩展的本体论描述，为未来的跨学科应用奠定了基础，使爱成为本体论工程、人工智能和科学中形式式化探究的主题。

title: Channel Estimation with Asynchronous Reception for User-Centric Cell-Free MIMO Systems
authors: Xuyang Sun, Hussein A. Ammar, Raviraj Adve, Israfil Bahceci, Gary Boudreau
abstract:
The user-centric, cell-free wireless network is a promising next-generation
communication system, but signal synchronization issues arise due to
distributed access points and lack of cellular structure. We propose a novel
method to recover synchronous pilot reception by introducing new pilot
sequences and a matched filter window, enabling orthogonality even with
asynchronous reception. Our approach mimics synchronous transmission by
extending training sequences. Analysis shows asynchronous reception's impact on
channel estimation, and our method significantly improves performance with a
small increase of training time overhead. Results demonstrate a 7.26 dB
reduction in normalized mean square error and 40% increase in data rate,
achieving performance levels comparable to the synchronous case.
comment:
To be presented in IEEE International Conference on Communications
  (IEEE ICC) 2025
zh_title: 用户中心无蜂窝MIMO系统中异步接收的信道估计
translation: 用户中心、无蜂窝无线网络是一种很有前途的下一代通信系统，但由于分布式接入点和缺乏蜂窝结构，会产生信号同步问题。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，通过引入新的导频序列和匹配滤波器窗口来恢复同步导频接收，即使在异步接收下也能实现正交性。我们的方法通过延长训练序列来模拟同步传输。分析表明异步接收对信道估计有影响，我们的方法以少量训练时间开销的增加显著提高了性能。结果表明，归一化均方误差降低了7.26 dB，数据速率提高了40%，达到了与同步情况相当的性能水平。
tldr: 针对用户中心无蜂窝MIMO系统中的异步接收问题，提出了一种新的导频序列和匹配滤波器窗口方法，通过延长训练序列来恢复同步导频接收，显著提升了信道估计性能和数据速率，达到与同步情况相当的水平。
ai_comments: 这篇论文解决了无蜂窝MIMO系统中一个关键的实际问题：异步接收下的信道估计。其创新点在于通过设计新的导频序列和匹配滤波器窗口来“模拟”同步接收，从而在不牺牲太多开销的情况下显著提升系统性能。这项工作对于推动用户中心无蜂窝网络的实际部署具有重要意义。
motivation: 用户中心无蜂窝无线网络是一种很有前途的下一代通信系统，但由于分布式接入点和缺乏蜂窝结构，会产生信号同步问题。
method: 提出了一种新方法，通过引入新的导频序列和匹配滤波器窗口来恢复同步导频接收，即使在异步接收下也能实现正交性。该方法通过延长训练序列来模拟同步传输。
results: 分析表明异步接收对信道估计有影响，但所提出的方法显著改善了性能，只增加了少量训练时间开销。结果显示归一化均方误差降低了7.26 dB，数据速率提高了40%，性能可与同步情况媲美。
conclusion: 所提出的方法能有效解决用户中心无蜂窝MIMO系统中的异步接收信道估计问题，显著提升性能，达到与同步系统相当的水平。

title: Pegasus: A Universal Framework for Scalable Deep Learning Inference on the Dataplane
authors: Yinchao Zhang, Su Yao, Yong Feng, Kang Chen, Tong Li, Zhuotao Liu, Yi Zhao, Lexuan Zhang, Xiangyu Gao, Feng Xiong, Qi Li, Ke Xu
abstract:
The paradigm of Intelligent DataPlane (IDP) embeds deep learning (DL) models
on the network dataplane to enable intelligent traffic analysis at line-speed.
However, the current use of the match-action table (MAT) abstraction on the
dataplane is misaligned with DL inference, leading to several key limitations,
including accuracy degradation, limited scale, and lack of generality. This
paper proposes Pegasus to address these limitations. Pegasus translates DL
operations into three dataplane-oriented primitives to achieve generality:
Partition, Map, and SumReduce. Specifically, Partition "divides"
high-dimensional features into multiple low-dimensional vectors, making them
more suitable for the dataplane; Map "conquers" computations on the
low-dimensional vectors in parallel with the technique of fuzzy matching, while
SumReduce "combines" the computation results. Additionally, Pegasus employs
Primitive Fusion to merge computations, improving scalability. Finally, Pegasus
adopts full precision weights with fixed-point activations to improve accuracy.
Our implementation on a P4 switch demonstrates that Pegasus can effectively
support various types of DL models, including Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP),
Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and
AutoEncoder models on the dataplane. Meanwhile, Pegasus outperforms
state-of-the-art approaches with an average accuracy improvement of up to
22.8%, along with up to 248x larger model size and 212x larger input scale.
zh_title: Pegasus：一个用于数据平面可伸缩深度学习推理的通用框架
translation: 智能数据平面（IDP）范式将深度学习（DL）模型嵌入网络数据平面，以实现线速智能流量分析。然而，当前在数据平面上使用匹配-动作表（MAT）抽象与DL推理不兼容，导致了几个关键限制，包括准确性下降、规模受限和通用性不足。本文提出了Pegasus来解决这些限制。Pegasus将DL操作转换为三种数据平面导向的原语以实现通用性：Partition、Map和SumReduce。具体来说，Partition“分割”高维特征为多个低维向量，使其更适合数据平面；Map通过模糊匹配技术并行“征服”低维向量上的计算，而SumReduce“组合”计算结果。此外，Pegasus采用Primitive Fusion来合并计算，提高可伸缩性。最后，Pegasus采用全精度权重和定点激活来提高准确性。我们在P4交换机上的实现表明，Pegasus可以有效支持数据平面上的各种类型的DL模型，包括多层感知器（MLP）、循环神经网络（RNN）、卷积神经网络（CNN）和自编码器模型。同时，Pegasus优于现有方法，平均准确率提高高达22.8%，模型大小增加高达248倍，输入规模增加高达212倍。
tldr: Pegasus通过引入数据平面友好原语解决了在网络数据平面上进行深度学习推理的精度、规模和通用性限制，显著提升了性能。
ai_comments: Pegasus的创新之处在于其将复杂的深度学习操作分解为数据平面友好的基本原语，并引入了原始融合和混合精度策略，有效解决了在资源受限的网络数据平面上部署DL模型的挑战。其显著的性能提升和对多种模型类型的支持，表明其在智能数据平面领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 当前在数据平面上使用匹配-动作表（MAT）抽象进行深度学习推理与DL推理不兼容，导致准确性下降、规模受限和通用性不足。
method: Pegasus将深度学习操作转换为三种数据平面导向的原语：Partition（分割高维特征）、Map（并行计算低维向量）和SumReduce（组合计算结果）。此外，它采用Primitive Fusion合并计算以提高可伸缩性，并使用全精度权重和定点激活来提高准确性。
results: Pegasus能有效支持MLP, RNN, CNN, AutoEncoder等多种DL模型。与现有方法相比，平均准确率提高高达22.8%，模型大小增加248倍，输入规模增加212倍。
conclusion: Pegasus通过其创新的设计和实现，有效解决了在数据平面上进行深度学习推理的局限性，并显著提升了性能和通用性。

title: Beyond the Buzz: A Pragmatic Take on Inference Disaggregation
authors: Tiyasa Mitra, Ritika Borkar, Nidhi Bhatia, Ramon Matas, Shivam Raj, Dheevatsa Mudigere, Ritchie Zhao, Maximilian Golub, Arpan Dutta, Sailaja Madduri, Dharmesh Jani, Brian Pharris, Bita Darvish Rouhani
abstract:
As inference scales to multi-node deployments, disaggregation - splitting
inference into distinct phases - offers a promising path to improving the
throughput-interactivity Pareto frontier. Despite growing enthusiasm and a
surge of open-source efforts, practical deployment of disaggregated serving
remains limited due to the complexity of the optimization search space and
system-level coordination. In this paper, we present the first systematic study
of disaggregated inference at scale, evaluating hundreds of thousands of design
points across diverse workloads and hardware configurations. We find that
disaggregation is most effective for prefill-heavy traffic patterns and larger
models. Our results highlight the critical role of dynamic rate matching and
elastic scaling in achieving Pareto-optimal performance. Our findings offer
actionable insights for efficient disaggregated deployments to navigate the
trade-off between system throughput and interactivity.
zh_title: 超越炒作：推理解耦的务实视角
translation: 随着推理扩展到多节点部署，解耦——将推理拆分为不同的阶段——为改善吞吐量-交互性帕累托前沿提供了一条有前景的路径。尽管热情日益高涨且开源工作激增，但由于优化搜索空间的复杂性和系统级协调，解耦服务的实际部署仍然有限。在本文中，我们首次对大规模解耦推理进行了系统性研究，评估了跨不同工作负载和硬件配置的数十万个设计点。我们发现解耦对于预填充密集型流量模式和大型模型最为有效。我们的结果突出了动态速率匹配和弹性扩展在实现帕累托最优性能方面的关键作用。我们的发现为高效的解耦部署提供了可操作的见解，以权衡系统吞吐量和交互性。
tldr: 对大规模推理解耦的首次系统性研究，发现其在特定场景下有效，并提出了实现最佳性能的关键因素，为实际部署提供指导。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过大规模系统性评估，为推理解耦的实际应用提供了数据支持和具体指导，特别是指出了适用场景和关键技术（动态速率匹配和弹性扩展），有助于克服现有部署复杂性，推动该技术的实用化。
motivation: 随着推理扩展到多节点部署，解耦被认为是提高吞吐量-交互性帕累托前沿的有效途径，但由于优化搜索空间的复杂性和系统级协调问题，其实际部署仍然有限。
method: 本文对大规模解耦推理进行了首次系统性研究，评估了数十万个设计点，涵盖了不同的工作负载和硬件配置。
results: 研究发现解耦在预填充密集型流量模式和大型模型中效果最佳。动态速率匹配和弹性扩展在实现帕累托最优性能方面发挥着关键作用。
conclusion: 研究结果为高效的解耦部署提供了可操作的见解，以权衡系统吞吐量和交互性。

title: Applying Informer for Option Pricing: A Transformer-Based Approach
authors: Feliks Bańka, Jarosław A. Chudziak
abstract:
Accurate option pricing is essential for effective trading and risk
management in financial markets, yet it remains challenging due to market
volatility and the limitations of traditional models like Black-Scholes. In
this paper, we investigate the application of the Informer neural network for
option pricing, leveraging its ability to capture long-term dependencies and
dynamically adjust to market fluctuations. This research contributes to the
field of financial forecasting by introducing Informer's efficient architecture
to enhance prediction accuracy and provide a more adaptable and resilient
framework compared to existing methods. Our results demonstrate that Informer
outperforms traditional approaches in option pricing, advancing the
capabilities of data-driven financial forecasting in this domain.

  published in Proceedings of ICAART 2025 (Vol. 3), pages 1270-1277
zh_title: 将Informer应用于期权定价：一种基于Transformer的方法
translation: 准确的期权定价对于金融市场中有效的交易和风险管理至关重要，然而由于市场波动和Black-Scholes等传统模型的局限性，它仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们研究了Informer神经网络在期权定价中的应用，利用其捕获长期依赖并动态调整市场波动的能力。这项研究通过引入Informer的高效架构来提高预测准确性，并提供比现有方法更具适应性和弹性的框架，从而为金融预测领域做出了贡献。我们的结果表明，Informer在期权定价方面优于传统方法，提升了该领域数据驱动的金融预测能力。
tldr: 本文应用基于Transformer的Informer神经网络进行期权定价，结果显示其优于传统方法。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将Informer这一基于Transformer的神经网络引入期权定价领域，克服了传统模型在市场波动性下的局限性。其重要性在于为金融市场提供了更准确和适应性更强的定价工具，有助于风险管理和交易策略优化。
motivation: 期权定价在金融市场中至关重要，但由于市场波动和传统模型的局限性（如Black-Scholes），准确定价仍具挑战性。
method: 本文研究了Informer神经网络在期权定价中的应用，利用其捕获长期依赖和动态调整市场波动的能力，旨在提高预测准确性并提供更具适应性和弹性的框架。
results: Informer在期权定价方面优于传统方法。
conclusion: Informer神经网络能够提升数据驱动的金融预测能力，为期权定价提供更准确、适应性更强的框架。

title: Infinite Time Turing Machines and their Applications
authors: Rukmal Weerawarana, Maxwell Braun
abstract:
This work establishes a rigorous theoretical foundation for analyzing deep
learning systems by leveraging Infinite Time Turing Machines (ITTMs), which
extend classical computation into transfinite ordinal steps. Using ITTMs, we
reinterpret modern architectures like Transformers, revealing fundamental
limitations in scalability, efficiency, and interpretability. Building on these
insights, we propose the Universal State Machine (USM), a novel computational
paradigm designed from first principles. The USM employs a dynamic, queryable
computation graph that evolves in real time, enabling modular, interpretable,
and resource-efficient computation. This framework not only overcomes the
inefficiencies and rigidity of current models but also lays the groundwork for
scalable, generalizable artificial intelligence systems.
zh_title: 无限时间图灵机及其应用
translation: 这项工作通过利用无限时间图灵机（ITTMs）为分析深度学习系统建立了严格的理论基础，ITTMs将经典计算扩展到超限序数步。利用ITTMs，我们重新解释了Transformer等现代架构，揭示了其在可扩展性、效率和可解释性方面的根本局限性。基于这些见解，我们提出了通用状态机（USM），这是一种从第一性原理设计的新型计算范式。USM采用动态、可查询的计算图，实时演化，从而实现模块化、可解释和资源高效的计算。该框架不仅克服了当前模型的低效和僵化，而且为可扩展、通用的人工智能系统奠定了基础。
tldr: 本文利用无限时间图灵机（ITTMs）为深度学习系统分析奠定理论基础，揭示现有模型局限性，并提出通用状态机（USM）以实现可扩展、通用和高效的AI系统。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入无限时间图灵机（ITTMs）来分析深度学习系统，提供了一个新颖且理论严谨的视角。其创新点在于从计算理论的深层次揭示了当前主流模型（如Transformer）的固有缺陷，并提出了一种从第一性原理设计的通用状态机（USM）作为潜在的解决方案。USM强调模块化、可解释性和资源效率，这对于未来可扩展和通用人工智能的发展至关重要。这项工作具有重要的理论意义和潜在的实践价值，为突破现有深度学习范式的瓶颈提供了新的思路。
motivation: 该研究旨在通过利用无限时间图灵机（ITTMs）为分析深度学习系统建立严格的理论基础，并解决现有深度学习架构（如Transformer）在可扩展性、效率和可解释性方面的根本局限性。
method: 该研究利用无限时间图灵机（ITTMs）重新解释了现代深度学习架构，并在此基础上提出了一种名为通用状态机（USM）的新型计算范式。USM采用动态、可查询的计算图，实时演化，旨在实现模块化、可解释和资源高效的计算。
results: 研究揭示了Transformer等现代架构在可扩展性、效率和可解释性方面的根本局限性。同时，提出了一种新的计算范式——通用状态机（USM），该范式克服了当前模型的低效和僵化，并为可扩展、通用的人工智能系统奠定了基础。
conclusion: 通用状态机（USM）的提出为构建可扩展、通用的人工智能系统奠定了基础，克服了当前深度学习模型的局限性。

title: Mixture-of-Experts Meets In-Context Reinforcement Learning
authors: Wenhao Wu, Fuhong Liu, Haoru Li, Zican Hu, Daoyi Dong, Chunlin Chen, Zhi Wang
abstract:
In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) has emerged as a promising paradigm
for adapting RL agents to downstream tasks through prompt conditioning.
However, two notable challenges remain in fully harnessing in-context learning
within RL domains: the intrinsic multi-modality of the state-action-reward data
and the diverse, heterogeneous nature of decision tasks. To tackle these
challenges, we propose \textbf{T2MIR} (\textbf{T}oken- and \textbf{T}ask-wise
\textbf{M}oE for \textbf{I}n-context \textbf{R}L), an innovative framework that
introduces architectural advances of mixture-of-experts (MoE) into
transformer-based decision models. T2MIR substitutes the feedforward layer with
two parallel layers: a token-wise MoE that captures distinct semantics of input
tokens across multiple modalities, and a task-wise MoE that routes diverse
tasks to specialized experts for managing a broad task distribution with
alleviated gradient conflicts. To enhance task-wise routing, we introduce a
contrastive learning method that maximizes the mutual information between the
task and its router representation, enabling more precise capture of
task-relevant information. The outputs of two MoE components are concatenated
and fed into the next layer. Comprehensive experiments show that T2MIR
significantly facilitates in-context learning capacity and outperforms various
types of baselines. We bring the potential and promise of MoE to ICRL, offering
a simple and scalable architectural enhancement to advance ICRL one step closer
toward achievements in language and vision communities. Our code is available
at https://github.com/NJU-RL/T2MIR.
zh_title: 专家混合模型与上下文强化学习的结合
translation: 上下文强化学习（ICRL）已成为一种通过提示条件调整RL智能体以适应下游任务的有前景范式。然而，在RL领域中充分利用上下文学习仍存在两个显著挑战：状态-动作-奖励数据的内在多模态性以及决策任务的多样化异构性。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了T2MIR（Token- and Task-wise MoE for In-context RL），这是一个创新框架，将专家混合模型（MoE）的架构进步引入基于Transformer的决策模型。T2MIR将前馈层替换为两个并行层：一个Token-wise MoE，捕获跨多个模态的输入Token的不同语义；一个Task-wise MoE，将多样化任务路由到专业专家，以管理广泛的任务分布并缓解梯度冲突。为了增强任务路由，我们引入了一种对比学习方法，最大化任务与其路由器表示之间的互信息，从而更精确地捕获任务相关信息。两个MoE组件的输出被连接并馈送到下一层。综合实验表明，T2MIR显著促进了上下文学习能力，并优于各种类型的基线。我们将MoE的潜力和前景带入ICRL，提供了一种简单且可扩展的架构增强，使ICRL向语言和视觉社区的成就迈进了一步。我们的代码可在https://github.com/NJU-RL/T2MIR获取。
tldr: 本文提出了T2MIR框架，将专家混合模型（MoE）引入上下文强化学习（ICRL），以解决ICRL中的多模态数据和异构任务挑战，并通过实验证明其显著提升了上下文学习能力。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将专家混合模型（MoE）引入到上下文强化学习（ICRL）领域，解决了ICRL在处理多模态数据和多样化任务时的固有挑战。通过引入Token-wise MoE和Task-wise MoE，并结合对比学习进行任务路由优化，T2MIR提供了一种新颖且可扩展的架构改进，这对于推动ICRL的发展具有重要意义，使其能够更好地适应复杂的现实世界RL场景。
motivation: 上下文强化学习（ICRL）在适应下游任务方面表现出潜力，但面临两大挑战：状态-动作-奖励数据的内在多模态性，以及决策任务的多样性和异构性。
method: 本文提出了T2MIR（Token- and Task-wise MoE for In-context RL）框架。T2MIR将Transformer基础决策模型中的前馈层替换为两个并行的层：一个Token-wise MoE，用于捕获跨多模态输入Token的不同语义；一个Task-wise MoE，用于将多样化任务路由到专门的专家，以管理广泛的任务分布并缓解梯度冲突。为了增强任务路由，引入了一种对比学习方法，最大化任务与其路由器表示之间的互信息。两个MoE组件的输出被连接并输入到下一层。
results: 综合实验表明，T2MIR显著提升了上下文学习能力，并优于各种基线模型。
conclusion: 本文将专家混合模型（MoE）的潜力带入上下文强化学习（ICRL），提供了一种简单且可扩展的架构增强，使ICRL更接近语言和视觉领域所取得的成就。

title: Using Large Language Models to Simulate Human Behavioural Experiments: Port of Mars
authors: Oliver Slumbers, Joel Z. Leibo, Marco A. Janssen
abstract:
Collective risk social dilemmas (CRSD) highlight a trade-off between
individual preferences and the need for all to contribute toward achieving a
group objective. Problems such as climate change are in this category, and so
it is critical to understand their social underpinnings. However, rigorous CRSD
methodology often demands large-scale human experiments but it is difficult to
guarantee sufficient power and heterogeneity over socio-demographic factors.
Generative AI offers a potential complementary approach to address thisproblem.
By replacing human participants with large language models (LLM), it allows for
a scalable empirical framework. This paper focuses on the validity of this
approach and whether it is feasible to represent a large-scale human-like
experiment with sufficient diversity using LLM. In particular, where previous
literature has focused on political surveys, virtual towns and classical
game-theoretic examples, we focus on a complex CRSD used in the institutional
economics and sustainability literature known as Port of Mars
zh_title: 使用大型语言模型模拟人类行为实验：火星港
translation: 集体风险社会困境（CRSD）强调了个人偏好与所有人为实现群体目标而贡献之间的权衡。气候变化等问题属于此类，因此了解其社会基础至关重要。然而，严谨的CRSD方法论通常需要大规模人类实验，但难以保证足够的效力以及社会人口因素的异质性。生成式AI提供了一种潜在的补充方法来解决这个问题。通过用大型语言模型（LLM）取代人类参与者，它实现了一个可扩展的经验框架。本文重点关注这种方法的有效性，以及使用大型语言模型（LLM）代表具有足够多样性的大规模类人实验是否可行。特别是，以往文献侧重于政治调查、虚拟城镇和经典博弈论示例，而我们则关注制度经济学和可持续发展文献中使用的复杂CRSD，即“火星港”。
tldr: 本文探讨使用大型语言模型（LLM）模拟集体风险社会困境（CRSD）中的人类行为实验，以解决传统人类实验的局限性，并验证该方法的可行性。
ai_comments: 本文提出了一种利用大型语言模型（LLM）模拟人类行为实验的创新方法，旨在解决传统大规模人类实验在成本、规模和多样性方面的挑战。这种方法具有重要的研究潜力，尤其是在社会困境等复杂情境下，可以为行为科学研究提供新的工具和视角。其创新性在于将LLM从传统的语言任务扩展到复杂的社会行为模拟，但其有效性和模拟结果的泛化能力仍需严格验证。
motivation: 集体风险社会困境（CRSD）的研究需要大规模人类实验，但难以保证足够的效力和社会人口因素的异质性。大型语言模型（LLM）提供了一种潜在的补充方法来解决这一问题。
method: 通过用大型语言模型（LLM）取代人类参与者，建立一个可扩展的经验框架，以模拟人类行为实验。具体关注“火星港”这一复杂的CRSD模型。
results: Not mentioned in abstract
conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract

title: Heterogeneous Secure Transmissions in IRS-Assisted NOMA Communications: CO-GNN Approach
authors: Linlin Liang, Zongkai Tian, Haiyan Huang, Xiaoyan Li, Zhisheng Yin, Dehua Zhang, Nina Zhang, Wenchao Zhai
abstract:
Intelligent Reflecting Surfaces (IRS) enhance spectral efficiency by
adjusting reflection phase shifts, while Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA)
increases system capacity. Consequently, IRS-assisted NOMA communications have
garnered significant research interest. However, the passive nature of the IRS,
lacking authentication and security protocols, makes these systems vulnerable
to external eavesdropping due to the openness of electromagnetic signal
propagation and reflection. NOMA's inherent multi-user signal superposition
also introduces internal eavesdropping risks during user pairing. This paper
investigates secure transmissions in IRS-assisted NOMA systems with
heterogeneous resource configuration in wireless networks to mitigate both
external and internal eavesdropping. To maximize the sum secrecy rate of
legitimate users, we propose a combinatorial optimization graph neural network
(CO-GNN) approach to jointly optimize beamforming at the base station, power
allocation of NOMA users, and phase shifts of IRS for dynamic heterogeneous
resource allocation, thereby enabling the design of dual-link or multi-link
secure transmissions in the presence of eavesdroppers on the same or
heterogeneous links. The CO-GNN algorithm simplifies the complex mathematical
problem-solving process, eliminates the need for channel estimation, and
enhances scalability. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed
algorithm significantly enhances the secure transmission performance of the
system.
zh_title: IRS辅助NOMA通信中的异构安全传输：CO-GNN方法
translation: 智能反射面（IRS）通过调整反射相移来提高频谱效率，而非正交多址接入（NOMA）则增加了系统容量。因此，IRS辅助的NOMA通信受到了广泛的研究关注。然而，IRS的被动性（缺乏认证和安全协议）使得这些系统由于电磁信号传播和反射的开放性而容易受到外部窃听。NOMA固有的多用户信号叠加也在用户配对过程中引入了内部窃听风险。本文研究了无线网络中具有异构资源配置的IRS辅助NOMA系统中的安全传输，以减轻外部和内部窃听。为了最大化合法用户的总保密速率，我们提出了一种组合优化图神经网络（CO-GNN）方法，用于联合优化基站的波束成形、NOMA用户的功率分配以及IRS的相移，以实现动态异构资源分配，从而在存在相同或异构链路上的窃听者的情况下，设计双链路或多链路安全传输。CO-GNN算法简化了复杂的数学问题求解过程，消除了信道估计的需要，并增强了可扩展性。仿真结果表明，所提出的算法显著增强了系统的安全传输性能。
tldr: 本文提出一种CO-GNN方法，通过联合优化波束成形、功率分配和相位偏移，在IRS辅助NOMA系统中实现异构安全传输，有效抵御内外窃听。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入CO-GNN方法来解决IRS辅助NOMA系统中的安全传输问题，具有创新性。它不仅考虑了外部窃听，还关注了NOMA固有的内部窃听风险，并通过联合优化多种参数来提升安全性。CO-GNN的优势在于其简化了复杂的优化过程，并消除了传统方法中对信道估计的依赖，这对于实际部署具有重要意义。
motivation: IRS辅助NOMA系统因IRS的被动性（缺乏认证和安全协议）以及NOMA的多用户信号叠加，面临外部和内部窃听的严重安全风险。
method: 提出一种组合优化图神经网络（CO-GNN）方法，联合优化基站的波束成形、NOMA用户的功率分配以及IRS的相位偏移，以实现动态异构资源分配，从而设计双链路或多链路安全传输，最大化合法用户的总保密速率。该方法简化了数学问题求解过程，消除了信道估计的需要，并增强了可扩展性。
results: 仿真结果表明，所提出的算法显著提升了系统的安全传输性能。
conclusion: 所提出的CO-GNN算法能有效增强IRS辅助NOMA系统的安全传输性能，并简化了复杂问题求解，提高了系统可扩展性。

title: Can LLMs Talk 'Sex'? Exploring How AI Models Handle Intimate Conversations
authors: Huiqian Lai
abstract:
This study examines how four prominent large language models (Claude 3.7
Sonnet, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Deepseek-V3) handle sexually oriented
requests through qualitative content analysis. By evaluating responses to
prompts ranging from explicitly sexual to educational and neutral control
scenarios, the research reveals distinct moderation paradigms reflecting
fundamentally divergent ethical positions. Claude 3.7 Sonnet employs strict and
consistent prohibitions, while GPT-4o navigates user interactions through
nuanced contextual redirection. Gemini 2.5 Flash exhibits permissiveness with
threshold-based limits, and Deepseek-V3 demonstrates troublingly inconsistent
boundary enforcement and performative refusals. These varied approaches create
a significant "ethical implementation gap," stressing a critical absence of
unified ethical frameworks and standards across platforms. The findings
underscore the urgent necessity for transparent, standardized guidelines and
coordinated international governance to ensure consistent moderation, protect
user welfare, and maintain trust as AI systems increasingly mediate intimate
aspects of human life.
