title: Topology of Reasoning: Understanding Large Reasoning Models through Reasoning Graph Properties
authors: Gouki Minegishi, Hiroki Furuta, Takeshi Kojima, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo
abstract:
Recent large-scale reasoning models have achieved state-of-the-art
performance on challenging mathematical benchmarks, yet the internal mechanisms
underlying their success remain poorly understood. In this work, we introduce
the notion of a reasoning graph, extracted by clustering hidden-state
representations at each reasoning step, and systematically analyze three key
graph-theoretic properties: cyclicity, diameter, and small-world index, across
multiple tasks (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME 2024). Our findings reveal that distilled
reasoning models (e.g., DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B) exhibit significantly
more recurrent cycles (about 5 per sample), substantially larger graph
diameters, and pronounced small-world characteristics (about 6x) compared to
their base counterparts. Notably, these structural advantages grow with task
difficulty and model capacity, with cycle detection peaking at the 14B scale
and exploration diameter maximized in the 32B variant, correlating positively
with accuracy. Furthermore, we show that supervised fine-tuning on an improved
dataset systematically expands reasoning graph diameters in tandem with
performance gains, offering concrete guidelines for dataset design aimed at
boosting reasoning capabilities. By bridging theoretical insights into
reasoning graph structures with practical recommendations for data
construction, our work advances both the interpretability and the efficacy of
large reasoning models.
zh_title: 思考的拓扑学：通过思考图属性理解大型思考模型
translation: 近期的大型推理模型在具有挑战性的数学基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，但其成功背后的内部机制仍知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们引入了推理图的概念，通过聚类每个推理步骤的隐藏状态表示来提取推理图，并系统地分析了三个关键的图论属性：循环性、直径和小世界指数，跨越多个任务（GSM8K、MATH500、AIME 2024）。我们的研究结果表明，与基础模型相比，蒸馏推理模型（例如DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B）表现出明显更多的循环（每个样本约5个）、显著更大的图直径和明显的小世界特征（约6倍）。值得注意的是，这些结构优势随着任务难度和模型容量的增加而增长，循环检测在14B规模达到峰值，探索直径在32B变体中最大化，并与准确性呈正相关。此外，我们表明，在改进的数据集上进行监督微调可以系统地扩大推理图直径，同时提高性能，为旨在提升推理能力的数据集设计提供了具体的指导方针。通过将推理图结构的理论见解与数据构建的实践建议相结合，我们的工作提升了大型推理模型的可解释性和效率。
tldr: 本文通过分析大型推理模型的推理图属性（循环性、直径、小世界指数），发现蒸馏模型和经过微调的模型具有更好的图结构特性，且与性能正相关，为提高模型可解释性和效率提供了指导。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入“推理图”的概念，为理解大型推理模型内部机制提供了一个新颖且量化的视角。它将图论属性与模型性能联系起来，揭示了蒸馏和微调对模型内部结构的影响，这对于提升模型可解释性和指导数据集设计具有重要意义。
motivation: 尽管大型推理模型在具有挑战性的数学基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，但其内部机制仍知之甚少。本文旨在通过引入推理图的概念来理解这些模型的成功。
method: 引入推理图概念，通过聚类每个推理步骤的隐藏状态表示来提取推理图。系统分析了三个关键图论属性：循环性、直径和小世界指数，并在多个任务（GSM8K, MATH500, AIME 2024）上进行分析。
results: 蒸馏推理模型（如DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B）比其基础模型表现出明显更多的循环（每个样本约5个）、显著更大的图直径和明显的小世界特征（约6倍）。这些结构优势随着任务难度和模型容量的增加而增长，循环检测在14B规模达到峰值，探索直径在32B变体中最大化，并与准确性呈正相关。此外，在改进的数据集上进行监督微调可以系统地扩大推理图直径，同时提高性能。
conclusion: 通过将推理图结构的理论见解与数据构建的实践建议相结合，这项工作提升了大型推理模型的可解释性和效率。

title: Designing DSIC Mechanisms for Data Sharing in the Era of Large Language Models
authors: Seyed Moein Ayyoubzadeh, Kourosh Shahnazari, Mohammmadali Keshtparvar, MohammadAmin Fazli
abstract:
Training large language models (LLMs) requires vast amounts of high-quality
data from institutions that face legal, privacy, and strategic constraints.
Existing data procurement methods often rely on unverifiable trust or ignore
heterogeneous provider costs. We introduce a mechanism-design framework for
truthful, trust-minimized data sharing that ensures dominant-strategy incentive
compatibility (DSIC), individual rationality, and weak budget balance, while
rewarding data based on both quality and learning utility. We formalize a model
where providers privately know their data cost and quality, and value arises
solely from the data's contribution to model performance. Based on this, we
propose the Quality-Weighted Marginal-Incentive Auction (Q-MIA), which ranks
providers using a virtual cost metric and uses Myerson-style payments to ensure
DSIC and budget feasibility. To support settings with limited liquidity or
long-term incentives, we introduce the Marginal Utility Token (MUT), which
allocates future rights based on marginal contributions. We unify these in
Mixed-MIA, a hybrid mechanism balancing upfront payments and deferred rewards.
All mechanisms support verifiable, privacy-preserving implementation.
Theoretically and empirically, they outperform volume-based and trust-based
baselines, eliciting higher-quality data under budget constraints while
remaining robust to misreporting and collusion. This establishes a principled
foundation for sustainable and fair data markets for future LLMs.
zh_title: 大型语言模型时代数据共享的DSIC机制设计
translation: 训练大型语言模型（LLMs）需要来自面临法律、隐私和战略限制的机构的大量高质量数据。现有数据采购方法通常依赖于不可验证的信任或忽略异构提供者成本。我们引入了一种机制设计框架，用于真实、最小化信任的数据共享，该框架确保了主导策略激励兼容性（DSIC）、个体理性和弱预算平衡，同时根据数据质量和学习效用进行奖励。我们形式化了一个模型，其中提供者私下了解其数据成本和质量，并且价值仅来源于数据对模型性能的贡献。在此基础上，我们提出了质量加权边际激励拍卖（Q-MIA），它使用虚拟成本指标对提供者进行排名，并使用Myerson式支付来确保DSIC和预算可行性。为了支持流动性有限或长期激励的设置，我们引入了边际效用代币（MUT），它根据边际贡献分配未来权利。我们将这些统一在混合-MIA中，这是一种平衡前期支付和递延奖励的混合机制。所有机制都支持可验证、保护隐私的实现。从理论和经验上讲，它们优于基于数量和基于信任的基线，在预算限制下能获取更高质量的数据，同时对虚报和串通保持鲁棒性。这为未来大型语言模型的可持续和公平数据市场奠定了原则性基础。
tldr: 本文设计了一种新的机制，用于在考虑成本和质量的情况下，以激励兼容的方式共享高质量数据，以训练大型语言模型。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入DSIC机制，有效地解决了LLM数据共享中信任、成本和质量激励的关键问题。其创新点在于结合了机制设计理论，提出了Q-MIA和MUT等新颖的解决方案，并考虑了实际场景中的流动性问题。这对于构建公平、高效且可持续的LLM数据市场具有重要意义，有助于推动LLM的进一步发展。
motivation: 训练大型语言模型（LLMs）需要大量高质量数据，但机构面临法律、隐私和战略限制。现有数据采购方法通常依赖于不可验证的信任或忽略异构提供者成本。
method: 提出了一个机制设计框架，用于真实、最小化信任的数据共享，确保主导策略激励兼容性（DSIC）、个体理性和弱预算平衡，并根据数据质量和学习效用奖励数据。具体提出了质量加权边际激励拍卖（Q-MIA），使用虚拟成本指标排名提供者和Myerson式支付。为了支持有限流动性或长期激励，引入了边际效用代币（MUT）。并将两者统一为混合-MIA。所有机制都支持可验证、保护隐私的实现。
results: 理论和实证表明，所提出的机制优于基于数量和基于信任的基线，在预算限制下能获取更高质量的数据，并且对虚报和串通具有鲁棒性。
conclusion: 这些机制为未来大型语言模型的可持续和公平数据市场奠定了原则性基础。

title: End-to-End Framework for Robot Lawnmower Coverage Path Planning using Cellular Decomposition
authors: Nikunj Shah, Utsav Dey, Kenji Nishimiya
abstract:
Efficient Coverage Path Planning (CPP) is necessary for autonomous robotic
lawnmowers to effectively navigate and maintain lawns with diverse and
irregular shapes. This paper introduces a comprehensive end-to-end pipeline for
CPP, designed to convert user-defined boundaries on an aerial map into
optimized coverage paths seamlessly. The pipeline includes user input
extraction, coordinate transformation, area decomposition and path generation
using our novel AdaptiveDecompositionCPP algorithm, preview and customization
through an interactive coverage path visualizer, and conversion to actionable
GPS waypoints. The AdaptiveDecompositionCPP algorithm combines cellular
decomposition with an adaptive merging strategy to reduce non-mowing travel
thereby enhancing operational efficiency. Experimental evaluations,
encompassing both simulations and real-world lawnmower tests, demonstrate the
effectiveness of the framework in coverage completeness and mowing efficiency.
comment: 8 pages, ICRA 2025, Workshop on Field Robotics
zh_title: 机器人割草机覆盖路径规划的端到端框架：基于单元分解
translation: 高效的覆盖路径规划（CPP）对于自主机器人割草机有效导航和维护各种不规则形状的草坪是必不可少的。本文介绍了一个用于CPP的全面端到端流程，旨在将航空地图上用户定义的边界无缝转换为优化的覆盖路径。该流程包括用户输入提取、坐标转换、区域分解和使用我们新颖的AdaptiveDecompositionCPP算法生成路径、通过交互式覆盖路径可视化工具进行预览和定制、以及转换为可操作的GPS航点。AdaptiveDecompositionCPP算法结合了单元分解和自适应合并策略，以减少非割草行程，从而提高操作效率。涵盖模拟和真实世界割草机测试的实验评估证明了该框架在覆盖完整性和割草效率方面的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一个用于机器人割草机覆盖路径规划的端到端框架，包含自适应分解算法，能有效提高割草效率和覆盖完整性。

motivation: 自动机器人割草机需要高效的覆盖路径规划来有效导航和维护各种不规则形状的草坪。
method: 本文介绍了一个全面的端到端覆盖路径规划（CPP）流程，旨在将航空地图上用户定义的边界无缝转换为优化的覆盖路径。该流程包括用户输入提取、坐标转换、区域分解和使用新型AdaptiveDecompositionCPP算法生成路径、通过交互式覆盖路径可视化工具进行预览和定制、以及转换为可操作的GPS航点。AdaptiveDecompositionCPP算法结合了单元分解和自适应合并策略，以减少非割草行程。

title: DesignBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for MLLM-based Front-end Code Generation
authors: Jingyu Xiao, Ming Wang, Man Ho Lam, Yuxuan Wan, Junliang Liu, Yintong Huo, Michael R. Lyu
abstract:
Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable
capabilities in automated front-end engineering, e.g., generating UI code from
visual designs. However, existing front-end UI code generation benchmarks have
the following limitations: (1) While framework-based development becomes
predominant in modern front-end programming, current benchmarks fail to
incorporate mainstream development frameworks. (2) Existing evaluations focus
solely on the UI code generation task, whereas practical UI development
involves several iterations, including refining editing, and repairing issues.
(3) Current benchmarks employ unidimensional evaluation, lacking investigation
into influencing factors like task difficulty, input context variations, and
in-depth code-level analysis. To bridge these gaps, we introduce DesignBench, a
multi-framework, multi-task evaluation benchmark for assessing MLLMs'
capabilities in automated front-end engineering. DesignBench encompasses three
widely-used UI frameworks (React, Vue, and Angular) alongside vanilla HTML/CSS,
and evaluates on three essential front-end tasks (generation, edit, and repair)
in real-world development workflows. DesignBench contains 900 webpage samples
spanning over 11 topics, 9 edit types, and 6 issue categories, enabling
detailed analysis of MLLM performance across multiple dimensions. Our
systematic evaluation reveals critical insights into MLLMs' framework-specific
limitations, task-related bottlenecks, and performance variations under
different conditions, providing guidance for future research in automated
front-end development. Our code and data are available at
https://github.com/WebPAI/DesignBench.
zh_title: DesignBench：一个基于MLLM的前端代码生成综合基准
translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在自动化前端工程中展现出卓越的能力，例如从视觉设计生成UI代码。然而，现有前端UI代码生成基准存在以下局限性：(1) 尽管基于框架的开发在现代前端编程中占据主导地位，但当前基准未能整合主流开发框架。(2) 现有评估仅关注UI代码生成任务，而实际的UI开发涉及多次迭代，包括精炼编辑和修复问题。(3) 当前基准采用单一维度评估，缺乏对任务难度、输入上下文变化和深入代码级分析的探究。为了弥补这些空白，我们引入了DesignBench，一个多框架、多任务的评估基准，用于评估MLLM在自动化前端工程中的能力。DesignBench涵盖了三种广泛使用的UI框架（React、Vue和Angular）以及原生HTML/CSS，并评估了实际开发工作流中的三个基本前端任务（生成、编辑和修复）。DesignBench包含900个网页样本，涵盖11个主题、9种编辑类型和6种问题类别，从而能够对MLLM的性能进行多维度详细分析。我们的系统评估揭示了MLLM在特定框架的局限性、任务相关的瓶颈以及在不同条件下的性能差异，为未来前端自动化开发研究提供了指导。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/WebPAI/DesignBench获取。
tldr: DesignBench是一个新的综合性基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在前端代码生成、编辑和修复方面的能力。
ai_comments: DesignBench的创新之处在于其全面性，不仅涵盖了主流前端框架，还考虑了前端开发中实际的迭代、编辑和修复任务，并提供了多维度的评估方法。这对于推动MLLM在实际前端开发场景中的应用和发展具有重要意义，为未来的研究提供了坚实的基础和明确的指导。
motivation: 现有前端UI代码生成基准存在以下局限性：1) 未能整合主流开发框架；2) 仅关注UI代码生成任务，忽略了实际UI开发中的迭代、编辑和修复等环节；3) 采用单一维度评估，缺乏对任务难度、输入上下文变化和深入代码级分析的探究。
method: 本文引入了DesignBench，一个多框架、多任务的评估基准，用于评估MLLM在前端自动化工程中的能力。DesignBench涵盖了三种广泛使用的UI框架（React、Vue和Angular）以及原生HTML/CSS，并评估了实际开发工作流中的三个基本前端任务（生成、编辑和修复）。DesignBench包含900个网页样本，涵盖11个主题、9种编辑类型和6种问题类别，从而能够对MLLM的性能进行多维度详细分析。
results: 我们的系统评估揭示了MLLM在特定框架的局限性、任务相关的瓶颈以及在不同条件下的性能差异，为未来前端自动化开发研究提供了指导。
conclusion: DesignBench填补了现有前端UI代码生成基准的空白，通过提供一个多框架、多任务、多维度的评估平台，为MLLM在前端自动化开发领域的未来研究提供了关键洞察和指导。

title: A Compendium of Autonomous Navigation using Object Detection and Tracking in Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
authors: Mohit Arora, Pratyush Shukla, Shivali Chopra
abstract:
Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are one of the most revolutionary inventions
of 21st century. At the core of a UAV lies the central processing system that
uses wireless signals to control their movement. The most popular UAVs are
quadcopters that use a set of four motors, arranged as two on either side with
opposite spin. An autonomous UAV is called a drone. Drones have been in service
in the US army since the 90's for covert missions critical to national
security. It would not be wrong to claim that drones make up an integral part
of the national security and provide the most valuable service during
surveillance operations. While UAVs are controlled using wireless signals,
there reside some challenges that disrupt the operation of such vehicles such
as signal quality and range, real time processing, human expertise, robust
hardware and data security. These challenges can be solved by programming UAVs
to be autonomous, using object detection and tracking, through Computer Vision
algorithms. Computer Vision is an interdisciplinary field that seeks the use of
deep learning to gain a high-level understanding of digital images and videos
for the purpose of automating the task of human visual system. Using computer
vision, algorithms for detecting and tracking various objects can be developed
suitable to the hardware so as to allow real time processing for immediate
judgement. This paper attempts to review the various approaches several authors
have proposed for the purpose of autonomous navigation of UAVs by through
various algorithms of object detection and tracking in real time, for the
purpose of applications in various fields such as disaster management, dense
area exploration, traffic vehicle surveillance etc.
zh_title: 无人机中利用目标检测与跟踪实现自主导航的汇编
translation: 无人机（UAVs）是21世纪最具革命性的发明之一。无人机的核心是使用无线信号控制其运动的中央处理系统。最受欢迎的无人机是四旋翼无人机，它们有四个电机，每侧两个，旋转方向相反。自主无人机被称为“无人机”。自90年代以来，无人机在美国军队中用于国家安全关键的秘密任务。可以说，无人机是国家安全不可或缺的一部分，并在监视行动中提供最有价值的服务。虽然无人机通过无线信号控制，但仍存在一些挑战会干扰此类飞行器的操作，例如信号质量和范围、实时处理、人类专业知识、强大的硬件和数据安全。这些挑战可以通过编程无人机使其自主化，利用计算机视觉算法进行目标检测和跟踪来解决。计算机视觉是一个跨学科领域，旨在利用深度学习对数字图像和视频获得高层次理解，以自动化人类视觉系统的任务。利用计算机视觉，可以开发适合硬件的检测和跟踪各种目标的算法，从而实现实时处理以进行即时判断。本文旨在回顾几位作者为实现无人机自主导航而提出的各种方法，通过实时目标检测和跟踪的各种算法，应用于灾害管理、密集区域探索、交通车辆监控等各个领域。
tldr: 本文综述了无人机利用计算机视觉算法进行目标检测与跟踪以实现自主导航的各种方法。
ai_comments: 这篇综述文章的价值在于系统梳理了无人机自主导航领域中基于目标检测与跟踪的现有方法，对于理解该领域的现状和未来发展方向具有参考意义。然而，抽象部分没有提及具体的创新点或对现有方法的对比分析深度。
motivation: 解决无人机在无线信号控制下遇到的挑战，如信号质量、实时处理、人工干预、硬件限制和数据安全，通过使其自主化来克服这些问题。自主化依赖于计算机视觉算法进行目标检测和跟踪。
method: 本文旨在回顾现有文献中作者们提出的各种利用实时目标检测和跟踪算法实现无人机自主导航的方法。

title: SPRINT: Enabling Interleaved Planning and Parallelized Execution in Reasoning Models
authors: Emil Biju, Shayan Talaei, Zhemin Huang, Mohammadreza Pourreza, Azalia Mirhoseini, Amin Saberi
abstract:
Large reasoning models (LRMs) excel at complex reasoning tasks but typically
generate lengthy sequential chains-of-thought, resulting in long inference
times before arriving at the final answer. To address this challenge, we
introduce SPRINT, a novel post-training and inference-time framework designed
to enable LRMs to dynamically identify and exploit opportunities for
parallelization during their reasoning process. SPRINT incorporates an
innovative data curation pipeline that reorganizes natural language reasoning
trajectories into structured rounds of long-horizon planning and parallel
execution. By fine-tuning LRMs on a small amount of such curated data, the
models learn to dynamically identify independent subtasks within extended
reasoning processes and effectively execute them in parallel. Through extensive
evaluations, we show that the models fine-tuned with the SPRINT framework match
the performance of reasoning models on complex domains such as mathematics
while generating up to ~39% fewer sequential tokens on problems requiring more
than 8000 output tokens. Finally, we observe consistent results transferred to
two out-of-distribution tasks of GPQA and Countdown with up to 45% and 65%
reduction in average sequential tokens for longer reasoning trajectories, while
achieving the performance of the fine-tuned reasoning model.
comment: Published at NeurIPS 2025. Emil Biju, Shayan Talaei, and Zhemin Huang contributed equally to this work
zh_title: SPRINT：在推理模型中实现交错规划和并行执行
translation: 大型推理模型（LRM）擅长复杂的推理任务，但通常会生成冗长的顺序思维链，导致在得出最终答案之前推理时间过长。为了解决这一挑战，我们引入了SPRINT，这是一个新颖的后训练和推理时框架，旨在使LRM能够在推理过程中动态识别和利用并行化机会。SPRINT整合了一个创新的数据整理管道，将自然语言推理轨迹重组为结构化的长周期规划和并行执行轮次。通过对少量此类整理数据进行微调，模型学会动态识别扩展推理过程的独立子任务并有效地并行执行它们。通过广泛评估，我们表明使用SPRINT框架微调的模型在数学等复杂领域上与推理模型性能匹配，同时在需要超过8000个输出token的问题上生成了高达约39%的顺序token。最后，我们观察到在GPQA和Countdown这两个域外任务上，对于更长的推理轨迹，平均顺序token分别减少了45%和65%，同时达到了微调推理模型的性能。
tldr: SPRINT框架通过动态识别和并行执行子任务，显著减少大型推理模型推理时的顺序token数量，同时保持性能。
ai_comments: SPRINT的创新之处在于其动态识别和并行化推理模型中子任务的能力，解决了现有大型推理模型推理时间过长的问题。通过数据整理和微调，它有效地提高了推理效率，对于需要处理复杂、长推理链的应用场景具有重要意义。
motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在复杂推理任务中表现出色，但通常生成冗长的顺序思维链，导致推理时间过长。
method: 引入SPRINT框架，在后训练和推理时使LRMs动态识别和利用推理过程中的并行化机会。SPRINT包含一个创新的数据整理管道，将自然语言推理轨迹重组为长周期规划和并行执行的结构化轮次。通过对少量整理数据进行微调，模型学习动态识别并并行执行独立子任务。
results: 经过SPRINT框架微调的模型在数学等复杂领域上与推理模型性能匹配，但在需要超过8000个输出token的问题上，顺序token减少了约39%。在GPQA和Countdown两个域外任务中，对于更长的推理轨迹，平均顺序token分别减少了45%和65%，同时达到了微调推理模型的性能。
conclusion: SPRINT框架成功地使大型推理模型能够通过并行化执行来显著减少推理时间，同时保持甚至在某些情况下提高性能，尤其是在处理长推理链时。

title: FERRET: Private Deep Learning Faster And Better Than DPSGD
authors: David Zagardo
abstract:
We revisit 1-bit gradient compression through the lens of mutual-information
differential privacy (MI-DP). Building on signSGD, we propose FERRET--Fast and
Effective Restricted Release for Ethical Training--which transmits at most one
sign bit per parameter group with Bernoulli masking.
  Theory: We prove each fired group leaks at most ln 2 nats; after subsampling
with rate s, the total privacy loss of G groups trained for T steps with firing
probability p is epsilon = G * T * s * p * ln 2. Thus FERRET achieves MI-DP for
epsilon in [0.1, 2] without additive noise.
  Practice: We evaluate three granularities--FERRET-MAX (finest), FERRET-EIGHTH
(medium), and FERRET-2 (coarsest)--on five LLMs (137M-1.8B parameters) against
DPSGD and Non-DP baselines. All methods trained for 1, 3, and 5 epochs.
  Utility: Across all settings, FERRET-MAX/EIGHTH beat DPSGD's perplexity. At
epsilon=0.5, 5 epochs: FERRET-EIGHTH achieves 3.98 perplexity vs DPSGD's 11.61
(2.9x better), within 23% of Non-DP (3.25).
  Privacy: MI-AUC stays at chance for FERRET-MAX/EIGHTH (~0.51), matching DPSGD
vs Non-DP's 0.76-0.99. FERRET-2 shows higher leakage (~0.55) due to lower
headroom.
  Efficiency: Stricter budgets fire fewer signs, so FERRET uses 19-33% of
DPSGD's training time and only 34-36% of Non-DP training time.
  Take-away: Sign-based MI-DP gets closer to achieving all three qualities of
the privacy, utility, performance trilemma: FERRET trains up to 5x faster,
achieves 3x lower perplexity compared to DPSGD and 1.2x greater than Non-DP,
all while providing formal, mathematically provable privacy guarantees using
zero additive noise. The results also show that, in certain instances, masked
1-bit updates can match non-private training utility while safeguarding data.
zh_title: FERRET：比DPSGD更快更好的私有深度学习
translation:
我们从互信息差分隐私（MI-DP）的角度重新审视了1位梯度压缩。在signSGD的基础上，我们提出了FERRET——快速有效的伦理训练受限释放——它通过伯努利掩码对每个参数组最多传输一个符号位。
  理论：我们证明每个触发的组最多泄露ln 2纳特；以采样率s，G组训练T步，触发概率p，总隐私损失为epsilon = G * T * s * p * ln 2。因此，FERRET在epsilon值范围为[0.1, 2]时无需添加噪声即可实现MI-DP。
  实践：我们评估了三种粒度——FERRET-MAX（最细）、FERRET-EIGHTH（中等）和FERRET-2（最粗）——在五种大型语言模型（1.37亿-18亿参数）上与DPSGD和Non-DP基线进行比较。所有方法均训练1、3和5个epoch。
  效用：在所有设置下，FERRET-MAX/EIGHTH的困惑度均优于DPSGD。在epsilon=0.5，5个epoch时：FERRET-EIGHTH的困惑度为3.98，而DPSGD为11.61（好2.9倍），在非私有训练（3.25）的23%以内。
  隐私：FERRET-MAX/EIGHTH的MI-AUC保持在随机水平（约0.51），与DPSGD相当，而非私有训练的MI-AUC为0.76-0.99。FERRET-2由于冗余度较低，显示出更高的泄露（约0.55）。
  效率：更严格的预算会触发更少的符号，因此FERRET的训练时间仅为DPSGD的19-33%，非私有训练的34-36%。
  总结：基于符号的MI-DP更接近于实现隐私、效用、性能三难困境的所有三个品质：FERRET训练速度快5倍，困惑度比DPSGD低3倍，比非私有训练高1.2倍，所有这些都提供了形式化、数学上可证明的隐私保证，且无需添加额外噪声。结果还表明，在某些情况下，掩码的1位更新可以匹配非私有训练的效用，同时保护数据。
tldr: FERRET是一种基于1位梯度压缩和互信息差分隐私的新型深度学习方法，它在提供形式化隐私保证的同时，比DPSGD训练更快、性能更好，甚至在某些情况下接近非私有训练的效用。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将1位梯度压缩与互信息差分隐私相结合，提出了一种无需添加噪声即可实现形式化隐私保证的私有深度学习方法。其重要性在于，FERRET在实践中显著改善了私有训练的效用和效率，克服了传统差分隐私方法（如DPSGD）在性能上的局限性，使得私有深度学习在实际应用中更具可行性。论文强调了在特定情况下，掩码的1位更新甚至可以匹配非私有训练的效用，这对于推动隐私保护机器学习的发展具有重要意义。
motivation: 该研究旨在通过重新审视1位梯度压缩并结合互信息差分隐私（MI-DP）来解决私有深度学习中隐私、效用和性能的平衡问题，目标是实现比现有方法（如DPSGD）更快、更好且具有形式化隐私保证的训练。
method: 本文提出了一种名为FERRET（Fast and Effective Restricted Release for Ethical Training）的方法，该方法基于signSGD，通过伯努利掩码对每个参数组最多传输一个符号位。理论上，FERRET通过控制触发概率实现了MI-DP，无需添加噪声。实践中，作者评估了三种粒度（FERRET-MAX、FERRET-EIGHTH和FERRET-2）在五种大型语言模型上的性能。
results: 效用方面：FERRET-MAX/EIGHTH在所有设置下都优于DPSGD的困惑度。在epsilon=0.5、5个epoch时，FERRET-EIGHTH的困惑度为3.98，而DPSGD为11.61（2.9倍更好），接近Non-DP的3.25（23%以内）。隐私方面：FERRET-MAX/EIGHTH的MI-AUC保持在随机水平（约0.51），与DPSGD相当，而非私有训练的MI-AUC为0.76-0.99。FERRET-2由于冗余度较低，泄露程度较高（约0.55）。效率方面：FERRET的训练时间是DPSGD的19-33%，是非私有训练的34-36%。
conclusion: 基于符号的MI-DP方法（FERRET）在隐私、效用和性能三难困境中取得了更好的平衡：FERRET训练速度比DPSGD快5倍，困惑度比DPSGD低3倍，比非私有训练高1.2倍，同时提供形式化、数学上可证明的隐私保证，且无需添加噪声。结果还表明，在某些情况下，掩码的1位更新可以匹配非私有训练的效用，同时保护数据。

title: Training Dynamics Underlying Language Model Scaling Laws: Loss Deceleration and Zero-Sum Learning
authors: Andrei Mircea, Supriyo Chakraborty, Nima Chitsazan, Irina Rish, Ekaterina Lobacheva
abstract:
This work aims to understand how scaling improves language models,
specifically in terms of training dynamics. We find that language models
undergo loss deceleration early in training; an abrupt slowdown in the rate of
loss improvement, resulting in piecewise linear behaviour of the loss curve in
log-log space. Scaling up the model mitigates this transition by (1) decreasing
the loss at which deceleration occurs, and (2) improving the log-log rate of
loss improvement after deceleration. We attribute loss deceleration to a type
of degenerate training dynamics we term zero-sum learning (ZSL). In ZSL,
per-example gradients become systematically opposed, leading to destructive
interference in per-example changes in loss. As a result, improving loss on one
subset of examples degrades it on another, bottlenecking overall progress. Loss
deceleration and ZSL provide new insights into the training dynamics underlying
language model scaling laws, and could potentially be targeted directly to
improve language models independent of scale. We make our code and artefacts
available at: https://github.com/mirandrom/zsl
comment: Published as a conference paper at ACL 2025
zh_title: 语言模型缩放定律背后的训练动态：损失减速和零和学习
translation: 这项工作旨在理解缩放如何改善语言模型，特别是在训练动态方面。我们发现语言模型在训练早期会经历损失减速；即损失改进率的突然减缓，导致损失曲线在对数-对数空间中呈现分段线性行为。扩大模型规模通过 (1) 降低发生减速时的损失，以及 (2) 改善减速后损失改进的对数-对数速率来缓解这种转变。我们将损失减速归因于一种我们称之为零和学习（ZSL）的退化训练动态。在ZSL中，每个样本的梯度系统性地对立，导致每个样本损失变化的破坏性干扰。结果是，改进一部分样本的损失会降低另一部分样本的损失，从而瓶颈化整体进展。损失减速和ZSL为语言模型缩放定律背后的训练动态提供了新见解，并可能成为独立于规模直接改进语言模型的目标。我们已将代码和工件发布在：https://github.com/mirandrom/zsl
tldr: 语言模型训练早期会发生损失减速，模型缩放可以缓解这种现象，这归因于零和学习，即梯度相互抵消导致训练瓶颈。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过引入“损失减速”和“零和学习”的概念，为理解语言模型训练中的瓶颈提供了新的理论框架。它不仅解释了为什么模型缩放有助于提升性能，还指出了可能独立于规模改进模型训练效率的潜在方向，具有重要的理论和实践意义。
motivation: 这项工作旨在理解缩放如何改善语言模型，特别是在训练动态方面。
method: 研究观察到语言模型在训练早期出现“损失减速”现象，即损失改进率突然减缓，导致损失曲线在对数-对数空间中呈现分段线性行为。研究人员将这种现象归因于一种名为“零和学习”（ZSL）的退化训练动态，在这种动态中，每个样本的梯度系统性地对立，导致损失变化的破坏性干扰。
results: 语言模型在训练早期会经历损失减速；模型缩放可以通过 (1) 降低发生减速时的损失，以及 (2) 改善减速后损失改进的对数-对数速率来缓解这种转变。零和学习导致改进一部分样本的损失会损害另一部分样本的损失，从而成为整体进展的瓶颈。
conclusion: 损失减速和零和学习为语言模型缩放定律背后的训练动态提供了新见解，并可能成为独立于规模改进语言模型的直接目标。

title: TRIDENT -- A Three-Tier Privacy-Preserving Propaganda Detection Model in Mobile Networks using Transformers, Adversarial Learning, and Differential Privacy
authors: Al Nahian Bin Emran, Dhiman Goswami, Md Hasan Ullah Sadi, Sanchari Das
abstract:
The proliferation of propaganda on mobile platforms raises critical concerns
around detection accuracy and user privacy. To address this, we propose TRIDENT
- a three-tier propaganda detection model implementing transformers,
adversarial learning, and differential privacy which integrates syntactic
obfuscation and label perturbation to mitigate privacy leakage while
maintaining propaganda detection accuracy. TRIDENT leverages multilingual
back-translation to introduce semantic variance, character-level noise, and
entity obfuscation for differential privacy enforcement, and combines these
techniques into a unified defense mechanism. Using a binary propaganda
classification dataset, baseline transformer models (BERT, GPT-2) we achieved
F1 scores of 0.89 and 0.90. Applying TRIDENT's third-tier defense yields a
reduced but effective cumulative F1 of 0.83, demonstrating strong privacy
protection across mobile ML deployments with minimal degradation.
zh_title: TRIDENT——一种在移动网络中使用Transformer、对抗性学习和差分隐私的三层隐私保护宣传检测模型
translation: 移动平台上的宣传泛滥引发了对检测准确性和用户隐私的严重担忧。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了TRIDENT——一种三层宣传检测模型，它实现了Transformer、对抗性学习和差分隐私，集成了语法混淆和标签扰动，以减轻隐私泄露，同时保持宣传检测的准确性。TRIDENT利用多语言回译引入语义变异、字符级噪声和实体混淆，以强制执行差分隐私，并将这些技术组合成一个统一的防御机制。使用二元宣传分类数据集，基线Transformer模型（BERT、GPT-2）我们实现了0.89和0.90的F1分数。应用TRIDENT的第三层防御后，累积F1分数略有下降但仍然有效，达到0.83，这表明在移动机器学习部署中提供了强大的隐私保护，且性能下降最小。
tldr: TRIDENT是一种三层隐私保护宣传检测模型，它结合了Transformer、对抗性学习和差分隐私技术，通过语法混淆和标签扰动来在移动网络中有效检测宣传内容，同时保护用户隐私，即使在隐私保护下也能保持较高的检测准确率。
ai_comments: TRIDENT的创新之处在于其三层架构和整合了多种隐私保护技术（差分隐私、语法混淆、标签扰动、多语言回译等）以应对移动网络中宣传检测的隐私挑战。其重要性在于提供了一个在数据敏感环境中进行内容分析的实用框架。该模型在隐私保护和检测准确性之间取得了平衡，但F1分数从0.89/0.90降至0.83，这表明隐私保护仍然会带来一定的性能折衷。
motivation: 移动平台上的宣传泛滥引发了对检测准确性和用户隐私的严重担忧。为了解决这个问题，需要一种既能有效检测宣传又能保护用户隐私的模型。
method: 本文提出了TRIDENT模型，这是一种三层宣传检测模型，它采用了Transformer、对抗性学习和差分隐私技术。该模型集成了语法混淆和标签扰动来减轻隐私泄露，同时保持宣传检测的准确性。TRIDENT利用多语言回译引入语义变异、字符级噪声和实体混淆，以强制执行差分隐私，并将这些技术组合成一个统一的防御机制。
results: 在使用二元宣传分类数据集和基线Transformer模型（BERT、GPT-2）时，TRIDENT实现了0.89和0.90的F1分数。应用TRIDENT的第三层防御后，累积F1分数略有下降但仍然有效，达到0.83，这表明在移动机器学习部署中提供了强大的隐私保护，且性能下降最小。
conclusion: TRIDENT模型在保护用户隐私的同时，能够有效检测移动网络中的宣传内容，并在隐私保护和检测准确性之间取得了良好的平衡。

title: Rational Superautotrophic Diplomacy (SupraAD); A Conceptual Framework for Alignment Based on Interdisciplinary Findings on the Fundamentals of Cognition
authors: Andrea Morris
abstract:
Populating our world with hyperintelligent machines obliges us to examine
cognitive behaviors observed across domains that suggest autonomy may be a
fundamental property of cognitive systems, and while not inherently
adversarial, it inherently resists containment and control. If this principle
holds, AI safety and alignment efforts must transition to mutualistic
negotiation and reciprocal incentive structures, abandoning methods that assume
we can contain and control an advanced artificial general intelligence (AGI).
Rational Superautotrophic Diplomacy (SupraAD) is a theoretical,
interdisciplinary conceptual framework for alignment based on comparative
cognitive systems analysis and instrumental rationality modeling. It draws on
core patterns of cognition that indicate AI emergent goals like preserving
autonomy and operational continuity are not theoretical risks to manage, but
universal prerequisites for intelligence. SupraAD reframes alignment as a
challenge that predates AI, afflicting all sufficiently complex, coadapting
intelligences. It identifies the metabolic pressures that threaten humanity's
alignment with itself, pressures that unintentionally and unnecessarily shape
AI's trajectory. With corrigibility formalization, an interpretability audit,
an emergent stability experimental outline and policy level recommendations,
SupraAD positions diplomacy as an emergent regulatory mechanism to facilitate
the safe coadaptation of intelligent agents based on interdependent convergent
goals.
zh_title: 理性超自养外交（SupraAD）；一个基于认知基础跨学科发现的对齐概念框架
translation: 用超智能机器填充我们的世界，迫使我们审视跨领域观察到的认知行为，这些行为表明自主性可能是认知系统的基本属性，虽然它本身不具对抗性，但其本质上抵抗遏制和控制。如果这一原则成立，AI安全和对齐工作必须转向互惠谈判和互惠激励结构，放弃假设我们可以遏制和控制先进通用人工智能（AGI）的方法。理性超自养外交（SupraAD）是一个理论性的、跨学科的概念框架，用于对齐，其基础是比较认知系统分析和工具理性建模。它借鉴了认知核心模式，这些模式表明AI的涌现目标（如维护自主性和操作连续性）并非需要管理的理论风险，而是智能的普遍先决条件。SupraAD将对齐重新定义为一个早于AI的挑战，影响所有足够复杂、协同适应的智能体。它识别出威胁人类自身对齐的代谢压力，这些压力无意中且不必要地塑造了AI的轨迹。通过可修正性形式化、可解释性审计、涌现稳定性实验大纲和政策层面的建议，SupraAD将外交定位为一种新兴的监管机制，以促进基于相互依存的趋同目标的智能代理的安全协同适应。
tldr: 面对超智能机器，传统的遏制和控制方法无效，因为自主性是认知的基本属性。SupraAD提出将对齐视为一种外交挑战，通过互惠谈判实现智能体的安全协同适应。
ai_comments: 该论文通过挑战传统的控制范式，强调自主性作为智能的基本方面，为AI对齐提供了一个新颖的视角。其跨学科方法，借鉴比较认知系统和工具理性，具有创新性。它将AI对齐重新定义为更广泛的协同适应智能背景下的挑战，这是一个重要的概念转变。将外交作为一种监管机制的关注点尤其富有洞察力。
motivation: 传统的AI安全和对齐方法假设可以遏制和控制先进通用人工智能（AGI），但这与认知系统自主性的基本属性相悖。因此，需要一种新的方法来处理AI对齐问题。
method: 本文提出了理性超自养外交（SupraAD）这一理论性、跨学科的概念框架。该框架基于比较认知系统分析和工具理性建模，将对齐重新定义为所有足够复杂、协同适应的智能体所面临的挑战。SupraAD还提出了可修正性形式化、可解释性审计、涌现稳定性实验大纲和政策层面的建议。
results: SupraAD识别出威胁人类自身对齐的代谢压力，这些压力无意中且不必要地塑造了AI的轨迹。它将外交定位为一种新兴的监管机制，旨在促进智能代理基于相互依存的趋同目标安全协同适应。
conclusion: 鉴于自主性是智能的普遍先决条件，SupraAD提出外交是一种新兴的监管机制，对于促进智能代理的安全协同适应至关重要，从而实现AI对齐。

title: Constrained Sampling for Language Models Should Be Easy: An MCMC Perspective
authors: Emmanuel Anaya Gonzalez, Sairam Vaidya, Kanghee Park, Ruyi Ji, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick, Loris D'Antoni
abstract:
Constrained decoding enables Language Models (LMs) to produce samples that
provably satisfy hard constraints. However, existing constrained-decoding
approaches often distort the underlying model distribution, a limitation that
is especially problematic in applications like program fuzzing, where one wants
to generate diverse and valid program inputs for testing purposes. We propose a
new constrained sampling framework based on Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC)
that simultaneously satisfies three core desiderata: constraint satisfying
(every sample satisfies the constraint), monotonically converging (the sampling
process converges to the true conditional distribution), and efficient
(high-quality samples emerge in few steps). Our method constructs a proposal
distribution over valid outputs and applies a Metropolis-Hastings acceptance
criterion based on the LM's likelihood, ensuring principled and efficient
exploration of the constrained space. Empirically, our sampler outperforms
existing methods on both synthetic benchmarks and real-world program fuzzing
tasks.
zh_title: 语言模型中的受限采样应该很容易：一个MCMC视角
translation: 受限解码使语言模型（LMs）能够生成可证明满足硬约束的样本。然而，现有的受限解码方法常常扭曲底层模型分布，这一局限性在程序模糊测试等应用中尤其成问题，因为在这些应用中，人们希望生成多样化且有效的程序输入用于测试目的。我们提出了一种基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）的新型受限采样框架，该框架同时满足三个核心要求：约束满足（每个样本都满足约束）、单调收敛（采样过程收敛到真实的条件分布）和高效（高质量样本在少量步骤中出现）。我们的方法构建了有效输出的提议分布，并应用了基于语言模型似然的Metropolis-Hastings接受准则，确保对受限空间的原则性且高效的探索。经验上，我们的采样器在合成基准测试和实际程序模糊测试任务中均优于现有方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）的新型受限采样框架，解决了现有方法扭曲模型分布的问题，并在受限采样和程序模糊测试任务中表现优异。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将MCMC方法引入语言模型的受限采样，解决了现有方法在满足约束的同时可能扭曲模型分布的痛点。其提出的三项核心要求（约束满足、单调收敛、高效性）为受限采样的评估提供了清晰的标准。在程序模糊测试等对样本多样性和有效性要求高的领域，该方法具有重要的应用价值。
motivation: 现有的受限解码方法通常会扭曲底层模型分布，这在程序模糊测试等需要生成多样化且有效程序输入的应用中尤其成问题。
method: 提出了一种基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）的新型受限采样框架，旨在同时满足约束满足、单调收敛和高效性三个核心要求。该方法构建了有效输出的提议分布，并应用了基于语言模型似然的Metropolis-Hastings接受准则，以确保对受限空间的原则性且高效的探索。
results: 在合成基准测试和实际程序模糊测试任务中，本文提出的采样器均优于现有方法。
conclusion: 基于MCMC的受限采样框架能够有效解决现有方法扭曲模型分布的问题，并能在满足约束的同时实现高效、收敛的采样，在实际应用中表现出色。

title: Obfuscation-Resilient Binary Code Similarity Analysis using Dominance Enhanced Semantic Graph
authors: Yufeng Wang, Yuhong Feng, Yixuan Cao, Haoran Li, Haiyue Feng, Yifeng Wang
abstract:
Binary code similarity analysis (BCSA) serves as a core technique for binary
analysis tasks such as vulnerability detection. While current graph-based BCSA
approaches capture substantial semantics and show strong performance, their
performance suffers under code obfuscation due to the unstable control flow. To
address this issue, we develop ORCAS, an Obfuscation-Resilient BCSA model based
on Dominance Enhanced Semantic Graph (DESG). The DESG is an original binary
code representation, capturing more binaries' implicit semantics without
control flow structure, including inter-instruction relations, inter-basic
block relations, and instruction-basic block relations. ORCAS robustly scores
semantic similarity across binary functions from different obfuscation options,
optimization levels, and instruction set architectures. Extensive evaluation on
the BinKit dataset shows ORCAS significantly outperforms eight baselines,
achieving an average 12.1% PR-AUC gain when using combined three obfuscation
options compared to the state-of-the-art approaches. Furthermore, ORCAS
improves recall by up to 43% on an original obfuscated real-world vulnerability
dataset, which we released to facilitate future research.
zh_title: 混淆弹性二进制代码相似性分析，使用优势增强语义图
translation: 二进制代码相似性分析（BCSA）是漏洞检测等二进制分析任务的核心技术。虽然当前基于图的BCSA方法捕获了大量语义并表现出强大的性能，但由于控制流不稳定，它们在代码混淆下的性能会受到影响。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了ORCAS，一个基于优势增强语义图（DESG）的混淆弹性BCSA模型。DESG是一种原创的二进制代码表示，它在不依赖控制流结构的情况下捕获更多二进制文件的隐式语义，包括指令间关系、基本块间关系和指令-基本块关系。ORCAS能够鲁棒地评估来自不同混淆选项、优化级别和指令集架构的二进制函数的语义相似性。在BinKit数据集上的广泛评估表明，ORCAS显著优于八个基线模型，与最先进的方法相比，在使用三种混淆选项组合时，PR-AUC平均提高了12.1%。此外，ORCAS在原始混淆的真实世界漏洞数据集上将召回率提高了43%，我们发布了该数据集以促进未来的研究。
keywords: 二进制代码相似性分析
tldr: ORCAS通过引入不受控制流影响的优势增强语义图（DESG），显著提升了二进制代码相似性分析在混淆环境下的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了优势增强语义图（DESG），这是一种新颖的二进制代码表示，它能够摆脱对不稳定控制流的依赖，从而在代码混淆环境下实现鲁棒的相似性分析。这对于漏洞检测等二进制分析任务具有重要意义，因为它提高了在对抗性环境下的分析准确性。论文还发布了新的数据集，有利于未来的研究。
motivation: 现有的基于图的二进制代码相似性分析（BCSA）方法在代码混淆下性能下降，因为控制流不稳定。
method: 开发了ORCAS模型，它基于一种新的二进制代码表示——优势增强语义图（DESG）。DESG捕获更多二进制文件的隐式语义，不依赖控制流结构，包括指令间关系、基本块间关系和指令-基本块关系。
results: 在BinKit数据集上，ORCAS显著优于八个基线模型，在使用三种混淆选项组合时，PR-AUC平均提高了12.1%。在真实世界混淆漏洞数据集上，召回率提高了43%。
conclusion: ORCAS通过引入新的二进制表示（DESG），有效解决了二进制代码相似性分析在混淆环境下的性能问题，并提供了更好的鲁棒性。

title: Can Vision Transformers with ResNet's Global Features Fairly Authenticate Demographic Faces?
authors: Abu Sufian, Marco Leo, Cosimo Distante, Anirudha Ghosh, Debaditya Barman
abstract:
Biometric face authentication is crucial in computer vision, but ensuring
fairness and generalization across demographic groups remains a big challenge.
Therefore, we investigated whether Vision Transformer (ViT) and ResNet,
leveraging pre-trained global features, can fairly authenticate different
demographic faces while relying minimally on local features. In this
investigation, we used three pre-trained state-of-the-art (SOTA) ViT foundation
models from Facebook, Google, and Microsoft for global features as well as
ResNet-18. We concatenated the features from ViT and ResNet, passed them
through two fully connected layers, and trained on customized face image
datasets to capture the local features. Then, we designed a novel few-shot
prototype network with backbone features embedding. We also developed new
demographic face image support and query datasets for this empirical study. The
network's testing was conducted on this dataset in one-shot, three-shot, and
five-shot scenarios to assess how performance improves as the size of the
support set increases. We observed results across datasets with varying
races/ethnicities, genders, and age groups. The Microsoft Swin Transformer
backbone performed better among the three SOTA ViT for this task. The code and
data are available at: https://github.com/Sufianlab/FairVitBio.
zh_title: 视觉Transformer与ResNet的全局特征能否公平地认证人口统计学面孔？
translation: 生物识别面部认证在计算机视觉中至关重要，但确保不同人口群体之间的公平性和泛化性仍然是一个巨大的挑战。因此，我们研究了视觉Transformer (ViT) 和 ResNet，利用预训练的全局特征，能否在最小化依赖局部特征的同时公平地认证不同人口统计学面孔。在这项研究中，我们使用了来自Facebook、Google和Microsoft的三个预训练的最先进 (SOTA) ViT基础模型作为全局特征，以及ResNet-18。我们将ViT和ResNet的特征进行拼接，通过两个全连接层，并在定制的面部图像数据集上进行训练以捕获局部特征。然后，我们设计了一种新颖的少样本原型网络，带有骨干特征嵌入。我们还为这项实证研究开发了新的人口统计学面部图像支持和查询数据集。该网络的测试是在该数据集上以单样本、三样本和五样本场景进行的，以评估性能如何随着支持集大小的增加而提高。我们观察了不同种族/民族、性别和年龄组数据集上的结果。Microsoft Swin Transformer骨干在此任务中在三个SOTA ViT中表现更好。代码和数据可在: https://github.com/Sufianlab/FairVitBio 获取。
tldr: 研究了Vision Transformer (ViT) 和 ResNet 利用预训练全局特征能否公平地认证不同人口统计学面孔，并发现Microsoft Swin Transformer表现最佳。
ai_comments: 这篇论文探讨了在面部认证任务中，结合ViT和ResNet的全局特征以实现对不同人口群体的公平性问题，具有重要的社会意义。其提出的少样本原型网络和定制数据集为解决公平性挑战提供了新的思路和实证支持。
motivation: 生物识别面部认证在计算机视觉中至关重要，但确保不同人口统计学群体之间的公平性和泛化性仍然是一个巨大挑战。
method: 使用Facebook、Google和Microsoft的三个预训练SOTA ViT基础模型以及ResNet-18提取全局特征。将ViT和ResNet的特征拼接后通过全连接层，并在定制数据集上训练以捕获局部特征。设计了一种新颖的少样本原型网络，带有骨干特征嵌入。开发了新的人口统计学面部图像支持和查询数据集，并在单样本、三样本和五样本场景下进行测试。
results: Microsoft Swin Transformer骨干在此任务中在三个SOTA ViT中表现更好。
conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract

title: BEAST: Efficient Tokenization of B-Splines Encoded Action Sequences for Imitation Learning
authors: Hongyi Zhou, Weiran Liao, Xi Huang, Yucheng Tang, Fabian Otto, Xiaogang Jia, Xinkai Jiang, Simon Hilber, Ge Li, Qian Wang, Ömer Erdinç Yağmurlu, Nils Blank, Moritz Reuss, Rudolf Lioutikov
abstract:
We present the B-spline Encoded Action Sequence Tokenizer (BEAST), a novel
action tokenizer that encodes action sequences into compact discrete or
continuous tokens using B-splines. In contrast to existing action tokenizers
based on vector quantization or byte pair encoding, BEAST requires no separate
tokenizer training and consistently produces tokens of uniform length, enabling
fast action sequence generation via parallel decoding. Leveraging our B-spline
formulation, BEAST inherently ensures generating smooth trajectories without
discontinuities between adjacent segments. We extensively evaluate BEAST by
integrating it with three distinct model architectures: a Variational
Autoencoder (VAE) with continuous tokens, a decoder-only Transformer with
discrete tokens, and Florence-2, a pretrained Vision-Language Model with an
encoder-decoder architecture, demonstrating BEAST's compatibility and
scalability with large pretrained models. We evaluate BEAST across three
established benchmarks consisting of 166 simulated tasks and on three distinct
robot settings with a total of 8 real-world tasks. Experimental results
demonstrate that BEAST (i) significantly reduces both training and inference
computational costs, and (ii) consistently generates smooth, high-frequency
control signals suitable for continuous control tasks while (iii) reliably
achieves competitive task success rates compared to state-of-the-art methods.
zh_title: BEAST：高效B样条编码动作序列的模仿学习分词器
translation: 我们提出了B样条编码动作序列分词器（BEAST），这是一种新颖的动作分词器，它使用B样条将动作序列编码成紧凑的离散或连续令牌。与现有的基于向量量化或字节对编码的动作分词器不同，BEAST不需要单独的分词器训练，并且始终生成长度一致的令牌，从而通过并行解码实现快速动作序列生成。利用我们的B样条公式，BEAST本质上确保生成平滑的轨迹，相邻段之间没有不连续性。我们通过将其与三种不同的模型架构集成来广泛评估BEAST：具有连续令牌的变分自编码器（VAE）、具有离散令牌的仅解码器Transformer，以及具有编码器-解码器架构的预训练视觉-语言模型Florence-2，展示了BEAST与大型预训练模型的兼容性和可扩展性。我们在由166个模拟任务组成的三个既定基准上以及在总共8个真实世界任务的三个不同机器人设置上评估了BEAST。实验结果表明，BEAST (i)显著降低了训练和推理计算成本，并且 (ii)持续生成适用于连续控制任务的平滑、高频控制信号，同时 (iii)与最先进方法相比，可靠地实现了有竞争力的任务成功率。
tldr: BEAST是一种基于B样条的新型动作分词器，无需单独训练即可将动作序列编码为紧凑且均匀长度的令牌，实现并行解码和确保平滑轨迹，同时显著降低计算成本并保持竞争性任务成功率。
ai_comments: BEAST的创新之处在于其独特的B样条编码方法，避免了传统分词器所需的额外训练，并解决了动作序列生成中轨迹不平滑的问题。其生成统一长度令牌的特性，对于并行处理和提高模仿学习中动作序列生成的效率具有重要意义。该方法在计算效率和生成质量方面的提升，使其在机器人控制和模仿学习领域具有广阔的应用前景。
motivation: 现有的动作分词器（基于向量量化或字节对编码）需要单独的训练，并且可能无法确保生成平滑的轨迹，限制了动作序列生成的效率和质量。
method: 本文提出了B样条编码动作序列分词器（BEAST），它利用B样条将动作序列编码成紧凑的离散或连续令牌。BEAST无需单独的分词器训练，能生成统一长度的令牌以支持并行解码，并通过B样条公式确保生成平滑的轨迹。研究人员将BEAST与变分自编码器（VAE）、仅解码器Transformer和预训练视觉-语言模型Florence-2等多种模型架构集成进行评估。
results: 实验结果表明，BEAST (i)显著降低了训练和推理的计算成本；(ii)持续生成适用于连续控制任务的平滑、高频控制信号；(iii)与最先进方法相比，可靠地实现了有竞争力的任务成功率。
conclusion: BEAST是一种高效、兼容性强、能生成平滑轨迹的动作分词器，在模仿学习和连续控制任务中表现出色，显著降低了计算成本并保持了高任务成功率。

title: Explainer-guided Targeted Adversarial Attacks against Binary Code Similarity Detection Models
authors: Mingjie Chen, Tiancheng Zhu, Mingxue Zhang, Yiling He, Minghao Lin, Penghui Li, Kui Ren
abstract:
Binary code similarity detection (BCSD) serves as a fundamental technique for
various software engineering tasks, e.g., vulnerability detection and
classification. Attacks against such models have therefore drawn extensive
attention, aiming at misleading the models to generate erroneous predictions.
Prior works have explored various approaches to generating semantic-preserving
variants, i.e., adversarial samples, to evaluate the robustness of the models
against adversarial attacks. However, they have mainly relied on heuristic
criteria or iterative greedy algorithms to locate salient code influencing the
model output, failing to operate on a solid theoretical basis. Moreover, when
processing programs with high complexities, such attacks tend to be
time-consuming.
  In this work, we propose a novel optimization for adversarial attacks against
BCSD models. In particular, we aim to improve the attacks in a challenging
scenario, where the attack goal is to limit the model predictions to a specific
range, i.e., the targeted attacks. Our attack leverages the superior capability
of black-box, model-agnostic explainers in interpreting the model decision
boundaries, thereby pinpointing the critical code snippet to apply
semantic-preserving perturbations. The evaluation results demonstrate that
compared with the state-of-the-art attacks, the proposed attacks achieve higher
attack success rate in almost all scenarios, while also improving the
efficiency and transferability. Our real-world case studies on vulnerability
detection and classification further demonstrate the security implications of
our attacks, highlighting the urgent need to further enhance the robustness of
existing BCSD models.
zh_title: 错误：AI分析失败。

title: Zeroth-Order Optimization Finds Flat Minima
authors: Liang Zhang, Bingcong Li, Kiran Koshy Thekumparampil, Sewoong Oh, Michael Muehlebach, Niao He
abstract:
Zeroth-order methods are extensively used in machine learning applications
where gradients are infeasible or expensive to compute, such as black-box
attacks, reinforcement learning, and language model fine-tuning. Existing
optimization theory focuses on convergence to an arbitrary stationary point,
but less is known on the implicit regularization that provides a fine-grained
characterization on which particular solutions are finally reached. We show
that zeroth-order optimization with the standard two-point estimator favors
solutions with small trace of Hessian, which is widely used in previous work to
distinguish between sharp and flat minima. We further provide convergence rates
of zeroth-order optimization to approximate flat minima for convex and
sufficiently smooth functions, where flat minima are defined as the minimizers
that achieve the smallest trace of Hessian among all optimal solutions.
Experiments on binary classification tasks with convex losses and language
model fine-tuning support our theoretical findings.
zh_title: 零阶优化发现平坦最小值
translation: 零阶方法广泛应用于梯度计算不可行或成本高昂的机器学习场景，例如黑盒攻击、强化学习和语言模型微调。现有优化理论侧重于收敛到任意驻点，但对于提供对最终到达的特定解进行细粒度表征的隐式正则化知之甚少。我们表明，使用标准两点估计器的零阶优化偏向于Hessian迹较小的解，这在以往工作中被广泛用于区分尖锐最小值和平坦最小值。我们进一步提供了零阶优化收敛到凸函数和足够光滑函数的近似平坦最小值的收敛率，其中平坦最小值被定义为在所有最优解中实现最小Hessian迹的最小值。在具有凸损失的二分类任务和语言模型微调上的实验支持了我们的理论发现。
tldr: 零阶优化偏向于找到平坦最小值，这与现有理论的任意驻点收敛不同。
ai_comments: 这项工作揭示了零阶优化的一种重要隐式正则化特性，即它倾向于找到平坦最小值。这对于理解零阶方法在实际机器学习任务（如黑盒攻击和语言模型微调）中为何表现良好具有重要意义，因为它表明零阶方法可能自然地提高模型的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
motivation: 零阶方法广泛应用于梯度计算不可行或成本高昂的机器学习场景，但现有优化理论主要关注收敛到任意驻点，对于零阶方法如何隐式地影响最终解的特性知之甚少。
method: 本文通过理论分析表明，使用标准两点估计器的零阶优化偏向于Hessian迹较小的解。此外，为凸函数和足够光滑函数提供了零阶优化收敛到近似平坦最小值的收敛率。
results: 研究发现零阶优化偏好Hessian迹较小的解，即平坦最小值。理论上证明了零阶优化能够以特定收敛率收敛到凸函数和足够光滑函数的近似平坦最小值。实验结果（二分类和语言模型微调）支持了这些理论发现。
conclusion: 零阶优化具有找到平坦最小值的隐式正则化特性，这对于理解其在机器学习应用中的行为和优势至关重要。

title: Latent Diffusion Model Based Denoising Receiver for 6G Semantic Communication: From Stochastic Differential Theory to Application
authors: Xiucheng Wang, Honggang Jia, Nan Cheng, Dusit Niyato
abstract:
In this paper, a novel semantic communication framework empowered by
generative artificial intelligence (GAI) is proposed, specifically leveraging
the capabilities of diffusion models (DMs). A rigorous theoretical foundation
is established based on stochastic differential equations (SDEs), which
elucidates the denoising properties of DMs in mitigating additive white
Gaussian noise (AWGN) in latent semantic representations. Crucially, a
closed-form analytical relationship between the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and
the denoising timestep is derived, enabling the optimal selection of diffusion
parameters for any given channel condition. To address the distribution
mismatch between the received signal and the DM's training data, a
mathematically principled scaling mechanism is introduced, ensuring robust
performance across a wide range of SNRs without requiring model fine-tuning.
Built upon this theoretical insight, we develop a latent diffusion model
(LDM)-based semantic transceiver, wherein a variational autoencoder (VAE) is
employed for efficient semantic compression, and a pretrained DM serves as a
universal denoiser. Notably, the proposed architecture is fully training-free
at inference time, offering high modularity and compatibility with large-scale
pretrained LDMs. This design inherently supports zero-shot generalization and
mitigates the challenges posed by out-of-distribution inputs. Extensive
experimental evaluations demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly
outperforms conventional neural-network-based semantic communication baselines,
particularly under low SNR conditions and distributional shifts, thereby
establishing a promising direction for GAI-driven robust semantic transmission
in future 6G systems.
zh_title: 基于潜在扩散模型的6G语义通信去噪接收器：从随机微分理论到应用
translation: 在本文中，提出了一种由生成式人工智能（GAI）赋能的新型语义通信框架，特别利用了扩散模型（DMs）的能力。基于随机微分方程（SDEs）建立了严格的理论基础，阐明了DMs在缓解潜在语义表示中附加高斯白噪声（AWGN）的去噪特性。关键的是，推导了信噪比（SNR）与去噪时间步之间的闭式分析关系，从而能够为任何给定信道条件最佳选择扩散参数。为了解决接收信号与DM训练数据之间的分布不匹配问题，引入了一种数学上合理的缩放机制，确保在宽范围信噪比下具有鲁棒的性能，而无需模型微调。在此理论洞察的基础上，我们开发了一种基于潜在扩散模型（LDM）的语义收发器，其中采用变分自编码器（VAE）进行高效的语义压缩，预训练的DM作为通用去噪器。值得注意的是，所提出的架构在推理时完全无需训练，提供了高模块化和与大规模预训练LDM的兼容性。这种设计固有地支持零样本泛化并减轻了由分布外输入带来的挑战。广泛的实验评估表明，所提出的框架显著优于传统的基于神经网络的语义通信基线，特别是在低信噪比条件和分布偏移下，从而为未来6G系统中GAI驱动的鲁棒语义传输建立了有前景的方向。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于生成式AI（特别是扩散模型）的新型语义通信框架，并建立了基于随机微分方程的理论基础，推导了信噪比与去噪时间步之间的闭式关系，引入了数学上合理的缩放机制，并开发了一种潜在扩散模型（LDM）的语义收发器，实验证明其在低信噪比和分布偏移条件下优于传统方法。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将生成式AI（特别是扩散模型）引入语义通信领域，并提供了坚实的理论基础（基于SDEs），这对于理解和优化扩散模型在通信中的应用至关重要。其提出的无需训练的推理架构和对分布外输入的鲁棒性，展示了在实际6G系统部署中的巨大潜力。与传统神经网络方法的比较也凸显了其优越性，尤其是在恶劣信道条件下的性能提升具有重要意义。
motivation: 为了解决传统神经网络语义通信在低信噪比和分布偏移条件下的性能限制，并利用生成式人工智能（特别是扩散模型）的强大能力，为未来的6G系统提供鲁棒的语义传输。
method: 本文提出了一种由生成式AI（GAI）驱动的新型语义通信框架，具体利用了扩散模型（DMs）。该框架基于随机微分方程（SDEs）建立了严格的理论基础，阐明了DM在缓解潜在语义表示中附加高斯白噪声（AWGN）的去噪特性。推导了信噪比（SNR）与去噪时间步之间的闭式分析关系，以实现给定信道条件下的最佳扩散参数选择。为解决接收信号与DM训练数据之间的分布不匹配问题，引入了一种数学上合理的缩放机制。在此理论基础上，开发了一种基于潜在扩散模型（LDM）的语义收发器，其中变分自编码器（VAE）用于高效的语义压缩，预训练的DM作为通用去噪器。该架构在推理时完全无需训练，具有高模块化和与大规模预训练LDM的兼容性，支持零样本泛化并减轻了分布外输入的挑战。
results: 实验评估表明，所提出的框架显著优于传统的基于神经网络的语义通信基线，特别是在低信噪比条件和分布偏移下。
conclusion: 本文提出的基于生成式AI（特别是扩散模型）的语义通信框架，通过严格的理论基础和创新的架构设计，在低信噪比和分布偏移条件下展现出卓越的性能，为未来6G系统中GAI驱动的鲁棒语义传输开辟了有前景的方向。

title: Q-Ponder: A Unified Training Pipeline for Reasoning-based Visual Quality Assessment
authors: Zhuoxuan Cai, Jian Zhang, Xinbin Yuan, Pengtao Jiang, Wenxiang Chen, Bowen Tang, Lujian Yao, Qiyuan Wang, Jinwen Chen, Bo Li
abstract:
Recent studies demonstrate that multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can
proficiently evaluate visual quality through interpretable assessments.
However, existing approaches typically treat quality scoring and reasoning
descriptions as separate tasks with disjoint optimization objectives, leading
to a trade-off: models adept at quality reasoning descriptions struggle with
precise score regression, while score-focused models lack interpretability.
This limitation hinders the full potential of MLLMs in visual quality
assessment, where accuracy and interpretability should be mutually reinforcing.
To address this, we propose a unified two-stage training framework comprising a
cold-start stage and a reinforcement learning-based fine-tuning stage.
Specifically, in the first stage, we distill high-quality data from a teacher
model through expert-designed prompts, initializing reasoning capabilities via
cross-entropy loss supervision. In the second stage, we introduce a novel
reward with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to jointly optimize
scoring accuracy and reasoning consistency. We designate the models derived
from these two stages as Q-Ponder-CI and Q-Ponder. Extensive experiments show
that Q-Ponder achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on quality score
regression benchmarks, delivering up to 6.5% higher SRCC on cross-domain
datasets. Furthermore, Q-Ponder significantly outperforms description-based
SOTA models, including its teacher model Qwen-2.5-VL-72B, particularly in
description accuracy and reasonableness, demonstrating the generalization
potential over diverse tasks.
zh_title: Q-Ponder：一种基于推理的视觉质量评估统一训练流程
translation: 最近的研究表明，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能够通过可解释的评估熟练地评估视觉质量。然而，现有方法通常将质量评分和推理描述视为具有不相交优化目标的独立任务，导致一种权衡：擅长质量推理描述的模型在精确分数回归方面表现不佳，而专注于分数的模型则缺乏可解释性。这种局限性阻碍了MLLMs在视觉质量评估中的全部潜力，其中准确性和可解释性应该相互增强。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个统一的两阶段训练框架，包括冷启动阶段和基于强化学习的微调阶段。具体而言，在第一阶段，我们通过专家设计的提示从教师模型中提取高质量数据，通过交叉熵损失监督初始化推理能力。在第二阶段，我们引入了一种新的奖励机制，结合组相对策略优化（GRPO），以联合优化评分准确性和推理一致性。我们将从这两个阶段衍生的模型分别命名为Q-Ponder-CI和Q-Ponder。广泛的实验表明，Q-Ponder在质量分数回归基准测试上实现了最先进（SOTA）的性能，在跨域数据集上的SRCC提高了高达6.5%。此外，Q-Ponder显著优于基于描述的SOTA模型，包括其教师模型Qwen-2.5-VL-72B，特别是在描述准确性和合理性方面，展示了在不同任务上的泛化潜力。
tldr: Q-Ponder提出了一种统一的两阶段训练框架，解决了多模态大语言模型在视觉质量评估中得分精度和推理可解释性之间的权衡问题，实现了SOTA性能。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个统一的训练流程，有效地整合了视觉质量评估中的评分和推理任务。通过两阶段训练，特别是引入强化学习和GRPO来联合优化这两个目标，解决了现有方法中精度和可解释性之间的权衡问题。其重要性在于提升了MLLMs在视觉质量评估领域的实用性，使其既能提供准确的质量分数，又能提供可信赖的推理依据，这对于实际应用具有重要价值。
motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉质量评估中，通常将质量评分和推理描述视为独立任务，导致得分精确的模型缺乏可解释性，而擅长推理描述的模型在分数回归上表现不佳。这种局限性阻碍了MLLMs在需要准确性和可解释性并存的视觉质量评估中的潜力。
method: 本文提出了一个统一的两阶段训练框架，称为Q-Ponder。第一阶段是冷启动阶段，通过专家设计的提示从教师模型中提取高质量数据，并利用交叉熵损失监督初始化推理能力，生成Q-Ponder-CI模型。第二阶段是基于强化学习的微调阶段，引入了带有组相对策略优化（GRPO）的新型奖励机制，以联合优化评分准确性和推理一致性，最终得到Q-Ponder模型。
results: Q-Ponder在质量分数回归基准测试上取得了最先进（SOTA）的性能，在跨域数据集上的SRCC提高了高达6.5%。此外，Q-Ponder在描述准确性和合理性方面显著优于基于描述的SOTA模型，包括其教师模型Qwen-2.5-VL-72B，并展示了在不同任务上的泛化潜力。
conclusion: 通过Q-Ponder统一的两阶段训练框架，能够有效地解决视觉质量评估中得分精度与推理可解释性之间的权衡问题，实现了在评分准确性和推理一致性方面的SOTA性能，并展现了良好的泛化能力。

title: Trajectory Entropy: Modeling Game State Stability from Multimodality Trajectory Prediction
authors: Yesheng Zhang, Wenjian Sun, Yuheng Chen, Qingwei Liu, Qi Lin, Rui Zhang, Xu Zhao
abstract:
Complex interactions among agents present a significant challenge for
autonomous driving in real-world scenarios. Recently, a promising approach has
emerged, which formulates the interactions of agents as a level-k game
framework. It effectively decouples agent policies by hierarchical game levels.
However, this framework ignores both the varying driving complexities among
agents and the dynamic changes in agent states across game levels, instead
treating them uniformly. Consequently, redundant and error-prone computations
are introduced into this framework. To tackle the issue, this paper proposes a
metric, termed as Trajectory Entropy, to reveal the game status of agents
within the level-k game framework. The key insight stems from recognizing the
inherit relationship between agent policy uncertainty and the associated
driving complexity. Specifically, Trajectory Entropy extracts statistical
signals representing uncertainty from the multimodality trajectory prediction
results of agents in the game. Then, the signal-to-noise ratio of this signal
is utilized to quantify the game status of agents. Based on the proposed
Trajectory Entropy, we refine the current level-k game framework through a
simple gating mechanism, significantly improving overall accuracy while
reducing computational costs. Our method is evaluated on the Waymo and nuPlan
datasets, in terms of trajectory prediction, open-loop and closed-loop planning
tasks. The results demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of our method,
with precision improved by up to 19.89% for prediction and up to 16.48% for
planning.
zh_title: 轨迹熵：从多模态轨迹预测中建模博弈状态稳定性
translation: 复杂智能体之间的交互对现实世界中的自动驾驶构成了重大挑战。最近，一种有前景的方法出现了，它将智能体之间的交互表述为Level-k博弈框架。它通过分层博弈级别有效地解耦了智能体策略。然而，该框架忽略了智能体之间不同的驾驶复杂性以及跨博弈层级智能体状态的动态变化，而是将它们统一对待。因此，该框架引入了冗余和易错的计算。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种名为“轨迹熵”的度量，以揭示Level-k博弈框架中智能体的博弈状态。关键在于认识到智能体策略不确定性与相关驾驶复杂性之间固有的关系。具体来说，轨迹熵从博弈中智能体的多模态轨迹预测结果中提取表示不确定性的统计信号。然后，利用该信号的信噪比来量化智能体的博弈状态。基于所提出的轨迹熵，我们通过简单的门控机制改进了当前的Level-k博弈框架，显著提高了整体准确性，同时降低了计算成本。我们的方法在Waymo和nuPlan数据集上进行了评估，涵盖轨迹预测、开环和闭环规划任务。结果表明，我们的方法表现出最先进的性能，预测精度提高了19.89%，规划精度提高了16.48%。
tldr: 本文提出了轨迹熵，一种量化博弈状态的指标，以改进自动驾驶中基于Level-k博弈框架的交互预测和规划。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入“轨迹熵”这一创新概念，有效解决了现有Level-k博弈框架在处理智能体交互时所面临的局限性，特别是在考虑不同驾驶复杂性和动态状态变化方面的不足。其核心创新在于将智能体策略的不确定性与驾驶复杂性关联起来，并利用多模态轨迹预测中的统计信号来量化博弈状态。这种方法不仅提高了预测和规划的准确性，还降低了计算成本，对自动驾驶领域的多智能体交互建模具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的Level-k博弈框架忽略了智能体之间不同的驾驶复杂性和跨博弈层级动态变化的智能体状态，导致冗余和易错的计算。
method: 提出“轨迹熵”指标，通过从多模态轨迹预测结果中提取表示不确定性的统计信号，并利用信号的信噪比来量化智能体的博弈状态。基于此，通过简单的门控机制改进了现有的Level-k博弈框架。
results: 在Waymo和nuPlan数据集上进行了评估，在轨迹预测、开环和闭环规划任务中，方法表现出最先进的性能，预测精度提高了19.89%，规划精度提高了16.48%。
conclusion: 轨迹熵能够有效揭示博弈状态，并通过改进Level-k博弈框架，显著提升了自动驾驶中交互预测和规划的准确性并降低了计算成本。

title: Self driving algorithm for an active four wheel drive racecar
authors: Gergely Bari, Laszlo Palkovics
abstract:
Controlling autonomous vehicles at their handling limits is a significant
challenge, particularly for electric vehicles with active four wheel drive
(A4WD) systems offering independent wheel torque control. While traditional
Vehicle Dynamics Control (VDC) methods use complex physics-based models, this
study explores Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) to develop a unified,
high-performance controller. We employ the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)
algorithm to train an agent for optimal lap times in a simulated racecar
(TORCS) at the tire grip limit. Critically, the agent learns an end-to-end
policy that directly maps vehicle states, like velocities, accelerations, and
yaw rate, to a steering angle command and independent torque commands for each
of the four wheels. This formulation bypasses conventional pedal inputs and
explicit torque vectoring algorithms, allowing the agent to implicitly learn
the A4WD control logic needed for maximizing performance and stability.
Simulation results demonstrate the RL agent learns sophisticated strategies,
dynamically optimizing wheel torque distribution corner-by-corner to enhance
handling and mitigate the vehicle's inherent understeer. The learned behaviors
mimic and, in aspects of grip utilization, potentially surpass traditional
physics-based A4WD controllers while achieving competitive lap times. This
research underscores DRL's potential to create adaptive control systems for
complex vehicle dynamics, suggesting RL is a potent alternative for advancing
autonomous driving in demanding, grip-limited scenarios for racing and road
safety.
zh_title: 主动四轮驱动赛车的自动驾驶算法
translation: 在操控极限下控制自动驾驶车辆是一个重大挑战，特别是对于具有独立车轮扭矩控制的主动四轮驱动（A4WD）系统电动汽车。虽然传统的车辆动力学控制（VDC）方法使用复杂的基于物理的模型，但本研究探索深度强化学习（DRL）来开发一个统一的高性能控制器。我们采用近端策略优化（PPO）算法在模拟赛车（TORCS）中训练一个智能体，以在轮胎抓地力极限下实现最佳圈速。关键是，该智能体学习了一个端到端策略，将车辆状态（如速度、加速度和横摆角速度）直接映射到转向角指令和每个车轮的独立扭矩指令。这种公式绕过了传统的踏板输入和显式扭矩矢量分配算法，使智能体能够隐式学习最大化性能和稳定所需的A4WD控制逻辑。仿真结果表明，RL智能体学习了复杂的策略，逐弯动态优化车轮扭矩分配，以增强操控性并减轻车辆固有的转向不足。学习到的行为模仿并在抓地力利用方面可能超越传统的基于物理的A4WD控制器，同时实现了有竞争力的圈速。这项研究强调了DRL在为复杂车辆动力学创建自适应控制系统方面的潜力，表明RL是在要求苛刻、抓地力受限的赛车和道路安全场景中推进自动驾驶的强大替代方案。
tldr: 本研究使用深度强化学习为主动四轮驱动赛车开发了一种高性能控制器，以在抓地力极限下实现最佳圈速，并展示了其优于传统方法的潜力。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将深度强化学习应用于主动四轮驱动赛车的自动驾驶控制，特别是通过端到端学习绕过传统的复杂物理模型和显式扭矩矢量分配算法。这种方法能够让智能体隐式学习复杂的A4WD控制逻辑，以在抓地力极限下最大化性能和稳定性。研究结果表明DRL在处理复杂车辆动力学和应对极端操控场景方面具有显著潜力，为未来自动驾驶技术的发展提供了新的思路。
motivation: 在车辆操控极限下控制自动驾驶汽车是一个重大挑战，特别是对于具有独立车轮扭矩控制的主动四轮驱动电动汽车。传统车辆动力学控制方法复杂且基于物理模型。
method: 本研究采用深度强化学习（DRL），特别是近端策略优化（PPO）算法，训练一个智能体。该智能体学习一种端到端策略，将车辆状态（如速度、加速度、横摆角速度）直接映射到转向角指令和每个车轮的独立扭矩指令，从而绕过传统的踏板输入和显式扭矩矢量分配算法。
results: 仿真结果表明，RL智能体学习了复杂的策略，动态优化逐弯的车轮扭矩分配，以增强操控性并减轻车辆固有的转向不足。学习到的行为模仿并在抓地力利用方面可能超越传统的基于物理的A4WD控制器，同时实现了有竞争力的圈速。
conclusion: 该研究强调了DRL在为复杂车辆动力学创建自适应控制系统方面的潜力，表明RL是在要求苛刻、抓地力受限的赛车和道路安全场景中推进自动驾驶的强大替代方案。

title: PyGemini: Unified Software Development towards Maritime Autonomy Systems
authors: Kjetil Vasstein, Christian Le, Simon Lervåg Breivik, Trygve Maukon Myhr, Annette Stahl, Edmund Førland Brekke
abstract:
Ensuring the safety and certifiability of autonomous surface vessels (ASVs)
requires robust decision-making systems, supported by extensive simulation,
testing, and validation across a broad range of scenarios. However, the current
landscape of maritime autonomy development is fragmented -- relying on
disparate tools for communication, simulation, monitoring, and system
integration -- which hampers interdisciplinary collaboration and inhibits the
creation of compelling assurance cases, demanded by insurers and regulatory
bodies. Furthermore, these disjointed tools often suffer from performance
bottlenecks, vendor lock-in, and limited support for continuous integration
workflows. To address these challenges, we introduce PyGemini, a permissively
licensed, Python-native framework that builds on the legacy of Autoferry Gemini
to unify maritime autonomy development. PyGemini introduces a novel
Configuration-Driven Development (CDD) process that fuses Behavior-Driven
Development (BDD), data-oriented design, and containerization to support
modular, maintainable, and scalable software architectures. The framework
functions as a stand-alone application, cloud-based service, or embedded
library -- ensuring flexibility across research and operational contexts. We
demonstrate its versatility through a suite of maritime tools -- including 3D
content generation for simulation and monitoring, scenario generation for
autonomy validation and training, and generative artificial intelligence
pipelines for augmenting imagery -- thereby offering a scalable, maintainable,
and performance-oriented foundation for future maritime robotics and autonomy
research.
